releases.body:
New solution captures its first hole-in-one,

gives everyday golfers the chance to save

and share their own video highlights

COPENHAGEN, Denmark, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- From coaching studios to professional tournaments to driving ranges and indoor simulators around the world, Trackman has spent more than two decades bringing advanced golf technology to more players in more places.

Now the company is bringing the look and feel of professional golf coverage to everyday golfers on the course itself.

At the famous 17th hole at TPC Sawgrass, home of The Players Championship, a new Trackman system gives visiting golfers broadcast-style video of their own shots, complete with ball-flight tracers and detailed performance data.

Within days of the installation going live, Graham Hill of Sarnia, Ontario, Canada, became the first golfer to have a hole-in-one captured by the new technology.

Unlike most golfers lucky enough to make an ace, Hill has more than a scorecard and a great story to show for it.

The system uses tour-proven radar and camera technology to capture every shot from two perspectives — behind the tee and behind the green — with a tracer that follows the ball's full flight from both directions. The resulting video looks much like something you'd see during a televised golf event, with on-screen graphics identifying the course and hole, along with Trackman data parameters.

The video is displayed in near-real time on TVs around the golf facility, bringing the action on the course into the clubhouse and beyond. Players can also access their recordings afterward to keep, replay and share with friends and family.

Bringing technology to every part of the game

Trackman is the official provider of club and ball tracking and tracing data to the PGA Tour, building on a partnership that spans more than 20 years. The installation at Sawgrass uses the same radar technology deployed during PGA Tour tournaments and broadcasts, now making that technology available to golfers playing some of the world's most celebrated holes.

It's the latest example of Trackman's broader ambition to create a better game through advanced technology. The Trackman 4 launch monitor has become a trusted tool for players, coaches and clubfitters, providing precise data on club motion and ball flight. Trackman Range has transformed driving ranges into interactive practice and entertainment destinations, while Trackman simulators bring golf indoors for year-round play, practice, competition and coaching.

More recently, Trackman 360 has brought those technologies together along with the Trackman Golf app and business tools, creating a connected solution for golf clubs and their members.

The new system at TPC Sawgrass reflects that same philosophy, extending the possibilities beyond practice facilities and onto the course itself.

"We've spent more than 20 years finding new ways to use our technology to make golf better, whether that's helping tour players perform at their best or making the game more enjoyable for everyone else," said Trackman co-founder and CEO Klaus Eldrup-Jørgensen. "A lot of golfers dream about playing a hole like the 17th at Sawgrass, and some will only get that chance once. We thought it would be pretty special if they could take that moment home with them."

TPC Sawgrass was a natural choice for a preview installation, given both Trackman's longstanding partnership with the PGA Tour and the 17th hole's status as one of the most recognizable in golf.

"Playing the 17th hole at TPC Sawgrass is a bucket-list experience for golfers around the world," said Lee Smith, Vice President, TPC Sawgrass and The Players Championship. "Now, we're giving them the opportunity to experience it with the same technology used by the best players in the world, capturing their shots and giving them a new way to relive a moment they'll remember for a lifetime."

For Hill, who traveled from Canada to play the Stadium Course for the first time, the new technology delivered a particularly memorable souvenir.

"This is my fourth hole-in-one but it's the first one with video of it," Hill said. "It was very special to have this moment recorded. It's something I will remember for the rest of my life. Being able to watch and share this moment in the future is something I wouldn't have had without Trackman."

The system is currently being installed at selected venues worldwide, with wider commercial availability expected in 2028.

ABOUT TRACKMAN GOLF

Trackman is the world's leading developer of radar and optical tracking technology for use in golf performance analysis. Once exclusive to elite players and coaches, our products are now enjoyed by millions of golfers of all skill levels, with more than five billion shots tracked over the past year alone. The iconic Trackman 4 launch monitor is trusted by 1,000+ tour players, 15,000+ teaching professionals, equipment manufacturers, and clubfitters to provide ultra-precise data on all aspects of club motion and ball flight. With over 100,000 Trackman-powered bays worldwide, our Trackman Range and golf simulator solutions feature the best game improvement, virtual golf and entertainment software in the industry. Trackman business tools empower entrepreneurs to operate their facilities more efficiently and profitably. Trackman is the official provider of club and ball tracking and tracing data to the PGA Tour, DP World Tour and LPGA Tour for broadcast on TV and digital platforms. Established in Denmark in 2003 and founder-led ever since, we continue to push boundaries through relentless innovation, powered by a global team of 1,200+ specialists that includes the largest R&D team in golf. Because the journey to better never ends, and it's never made alone. TRACKMAN. FOR A BETTER GAME.

ABOUT TPC NETWORK

Owned, operated and licensed by the PGA Tour, the TPC Network is comprised of 31 premier private, resort and daily fee golf properties designed by some of golf's most elite architects. Fifteen of the clubs are operated by affiliates of PGA Tour Golf Course Properties, Inc. Each TPC meets the requirements to host Tour-sanctioned events. Since TPC Sawgrass first opened its world-renowned The Player Stadium Course in the fall of 1980, TPCs have provided the PGA Tourwith rent-free venues for tournaments, helping to boost championship golf purses and increasing charitable donations to grass roots non-profit organizations. At the same time, TPCs have provided recreational golfers with the unique opportunity to test their skills on the same layouts where the world's best golfers compete.

TPCs are known for their history of hosting PGA Tour-sanctioned events, their outstanding conditioning and amenities, as well as a commitment to environmental excellence. The TPC Network is also distinguished by its unwavering commitment to further the PGA Tour's mission of giving back through support of charitable and grass-roots programs. For more information, please visit www.tpc.com. For the most up-to-date news, follow the TPC Network on Twitter (@PlayTPC), Instagram (@PlayTPC) or Facebook.com/TPCNetwork.

ABOUT THE PLAYERS CHAMPIONSHIP

The Players Championship takes place at the world-class The Players Stadium Course at TPC Sawgrass, home to the iconic Island Green and features a field of the Tour's top players competing for one of golf's most coveted titles. Comcast Business, Optum®, and Morgan Stanley are the exclusive Proud Partners of The Players. Proceeds from The Players benefit Northeast Florida charities and have totaled more than $130 million since it began in 1974 and moved to Ponte Vedra Beach in 1977. For more on The Players, visit ThePlayers.com. For more on the surrounding areas, visit floridashistoriccoast.com or visitjacksonville.com.

releases.body:
Weekly newsletter from Housewives of Frederick County founder Pam Stultz reaches nearly 4,800 active subscribers with local news, events, dining and discoveries.

FREDERICK, Md., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- From restaurant openings to one-of-a-kind local experiences, there is always something happening in Frederick County. The Frederick Buzz, a free weekly email newsletter created by longtime local publisher Pam Stultz, helps residents stay in the know.

Stultz founded Housewives of Frederick County in 2012 and has expanded its community coverage through The Frederick Buzz, which currently has 4,794 active subscribers and arrives in readers' inboxes every Thursday morning.

"Frederick County has grown so much, and there's always something new to discover," said Stultz. "I want The Frederick Buzz to feel like getting an email from a friend who knows what's going on around town."

The newsletter highlights restaurant and business openings, community developments, seasonal activities and local recommendations. Regular features include Top 5 Things to Do This Weekend, Before They Sell Out, Buzz Around Frederick and Pam's Pick. Its Business Guide also features a curated selection of local businesses and services.

Local News Submissions

The Frederick Buzz welcomes newsworthy announcements from Frederick County businesses, organizations and public relations professionals, including new business openings, grand openings, community developments and distinctive local experiences. Submissions are considered for editorial coverage; inclusion is not guaranteed.

"One of my favorite things about covering Frederick County is discovering something new and sharing it with people who might otherwise miss it," said Stultz.

Residents can subscribe for free at https://the-frederick-buzz.beehiiv.com/. Local news tips and media inquiries may be sent to pamstultz@housewivesoffrederickcounty.com.

About Housewives of Frederick County

Founded in 2012 by Pam Stultz, Housewives of Frederick County is a locally owned lifestyle publication covering Frederick County restaurants, events, shopping, attractions, travel and community experiences. Its website, social channels and The Frederick Buzz newsletter help residents discover more of the area.

releases.title: Palmetto Publishing Introduces COACH CONQUEROR®, the Superhero Who Helps Children Discover the Hero Within
releases.body:
New children's book by Conqueror Roberts builds courage, confidence, and personal safety skills by making kids the heroes of their own stories.

CHARLESTON, S.C., Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Palmetto Publishing announces the publication of COACH CONQUEROR®, Volume One, a children's superhero book by life coach, mentor, and longtime youth and juvenile justice professional Conqueror Roberts.

Most superheroes win with strength, speed, or flight. Coach Conqueror's power is different: he helps children find the courage and confidence they already have, then lets them use it.

In ten stories, young readers meet children facing bullying, peer pressure, fear, self-doubt, and the wish to fit in. Coach Conqueror doesn't solve their problems for them. He listens, asks questions, and helps each child recognize their own strengths and choose what to do next.

"Every child has greatness within them. Sometimes they simply need someone to help them discover it," said Conqueror Roberts. "I wanted a superhero who doesn't just rescue children, but helps them find the courage and strength to overcome challenges themselves."

The stories show that real heroism lives in everyday choices: telling the truth, treating others with kindness, and doing what's right when it's hard. Each one carries a lesson in resilience, problem-solving, or responsible decision-making, and a reminder that a child's mistakes don't define their future.

COACH CONQUEROR® also helps children recognize unsafe situations, set healthy boundaries, and go to trusted adults for help. It teaches that children have the right to say no, ask questions, and speak up when something feels wrong.

Roberts brings more than 25 years in counseling, juvenile justice, and investigations to these lessons. That work showed him how much early education and open family communication protect children. The book handles these topics through encouraging stories, never through fear.

COACH CONQUEROR® is the foundation of a broader educational and motivational movement for children, families, educators, counselors, and communities. The book is built to start conversations at home, in classrooms, and in counseling and mentoring settings.

At the heart of the movement is a simple message: Stop Coping, Start Conquering®

Courage doesn't mean never feeling afraid. It means facing challenges, making responsible choices, and asking for help when it's needed.

COACH CONQUEROR®, Volume One, is available on Amazon.com and Barnesandnoble.com. 

About the Author

Conqueror Roberts is the creator and founder of COACH CONQUEROR®, a certified life coach, certified personal trainer, self-defense expert, and mentor. Since 1998, he has worked with children, adolescents, families, and adults facing behavioral and emotional challenges.

His career includes roles as a behavioral specialist, correctional counselor and officer, juvenile justice professional, law enforcement officer, investigator, and intelligence professional with the United States Department of Justice. He has also led training in crisis intervention and personal safety education.

Today Roberts carries his mission into life coaching, school and community programs, public speaking, and self-defense instruction.

"Some people wear capes," Roberts said. "My mission is to help people discover the hero within themselves."

releases.title: MobileFuse Expands Publisher Reporting Capabilities with Rill
releases.body:
New case study highlights expanded filtering and deeper visibility into advertiser KPIs across apps, domains, and individual ad placements.

NEW YORK, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MobileFuse today shared details of its work with analytics company Rill to expand publisher reporting capabilities covering nearly 4,000 app bundles and domains. A new Rill case study examines the collaboration behind the analytics available in Grove, MobileFuse's updated publisher dashboard, and how it gives publishers greater visibility into their inventory performance.

The reporting allows publishers to move from a high-level earnings overview to a granular analysis of their inventory, with filtering capabilities by app, domain, placement, integration path, OS, and property type. Publishers can easily drill down into their own data to understand how performance varies across their inventory.

Beyond earnings and eCPM, the reporting provides insights into key advertiser KPIs, including CTR, CVR, viewability, and fraud metrics. These metrics are available at the app, domain, and individual placement level, giving publishers the ability to quickly pinpoint performance trends, identify potential issues, and get to the root cause of any concerns.

"Publishers want to understand what's behind their earnings and be able to investigate when something changes," said Dan Barnett, EVP of Engineering at MobileFuse. "Our work with Rill gives them more ways to do that directly in the dashboard. It also makes it easier for our team to improve the reporting as their needs evolve."

MobileFuse runs approximately 440 billion ad auctions and sends more than 2 trillion outgoing bid requests each month. Modernizing publisher reporting required a way to make that volume of data useful to individual partners without building another analytics system to maintain.

Read the full case study for a closer look at the publisher reporting experience and Barnett's perspective on choosing and working with Rill: rilldata.com/case-study/mobilefuse-self-serve-publisher-analytics.

releases.body:
EAGLERIDER Announces 16-Day "Icons of America" Guided Motorcycle Tour From Nashville to New Orleans With Three Departures in 2027

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EAGLERIDER, the world's leading powersports experience company, today announced Icons of America, a 16-day guided motorcycle tour from Nashville, Tennessee to New Orleans, Louisiana.

EAGLERIDER launches Icons of America, a 16-day guided motorcycle tour from Nashville to New Orleans.

Over 16 days, 15 nights and 2,215 miles, riders follow the trail of Mark Twain, Walt Disney, Elvis Presley and Louis Armstrong North to South through whiskey country, Mississippi River towns, the Blues Trail and Cajun Louisiana.

Icons of America is built for riders who want more than mileage. No riding day runs longer than 240 miles, which leaves real time off the bike to walk around historic small towns, tour the distillery or catch live music. Three departures are scheduled for 2027: May 6, July 8 and September 16.

"In addition to visiting these iconic places, we made sure to include some bucket-list motorcycle roads, such as the Tail of the Dragon and Natchez Trace Parkway. This tour brings together the thrill of riding some of America's most celebrated roads with the charm of exploring historic Southern towns, their culture, and people," said Sebastian Schoepe, CEO of EAGLERIDER.

The route runs through the heartland of country, blues and rock and roll, with stops that include:

  • The Jack Daniel's Distillery in Lynchburg, Tennessee
  • Louisville, Kentucky and the Gateway Arch in St. Louis
  • Mark Twain's Boyhood Home in Hannibal, Missouri
  • The Walt Disney Hometown Museum in Marceline, Missouri
  • The Ozark foothills and Route 66 country around Springfield, Missouri
  • The Mississippi Blues Trail between Oxford and Jackson
  • and the Natchez Trace Parkway from Jackson to Natchez.

But there is more: Two Nights in Memphis

Day nine is a rest day in Memphis, Tennessee and riders can tour Graceland, the home of Elvis Presley, visit Sun Studio, where rock and roll was born, or settle in on Beale Street for live blues, with an optional Memphis barbecue experience on the side. The next morning the ride heads to the Elvis Presley Birthplace in Tupelo, Mississippi.

From there the route works south through Oxford, Jackson, Natchez and Baton Rouge before the final 80-mile run into New Orleans, the city of jazz legend Louis Armstrong, with Cajun food waiting at the end of the ride.

The guided Icons of America Tour runs May 6–21, July 8–23 and September 16 – October 1, 2027, delivering the full EAGLERIDER experience: premium accommodations, professional multilingual guides, support vehicle assistance, daily breakfast and fuel on riding days, luggage transport and a celebratory farewell party. Riders can choose from Harley-Davidson and Indian motorcycles. The tour runs one way, so riders fly into Nashville (BNA) and home from New Orleans (MSY). A valid motorcycle license from the rider's home country is required.

Pricing starts at $5,116 per person, based on two people sharing one motorcycle and one room. Taxes and fees are not included. Bookings close 45 days before each departure: March 22 for May, May 24 for July and August 2 for September.

New agreements with NBC Sports and ESPN join returning partners ION and CBS Sports, creating a national viewing platform for MLV's fourth season

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Major League Volleyball (MLV), America's longest-running indoor professional volleyball league, has announced a landmark lineup of media relationships for its 2027 season, bringing together NBC Sports, ESPN, ION and CBS Sports to deliver more national exposure and expanded access to professional women's volleyball. 

The expanded media portfolio marks a defining moment for MLV, positioning the league to reach new audiences through a consistent weekly viewing schedule, national broadcast television, streaming platforms and expanded over-the-air distribution. With new agreements with NBC Sports and ESPN along with returning partners Scripps Sports/ION and CBS Sports, MLV is building a broader platform for fans to follow the league athletes, teams, and competition throughout the season. 

The 2027 schedule is designed to establish a consistent rhythm for fans, with dedicated nights of volleyball across leading media platforms. A league-record total of 140 matches will be available through the four network partners.

A NEW WEEKLY DESTINATION FOR VOLLEYBALL FANS

MLV's 2027 media schedule will feature: 

  • Thursday Nights on Peacock: NBC Sports will present an MLV Match of the Week every Thursday on Peacock for 16 weeks, establishing a consistent weekly destination for fans to watch the league's top matchups. In addition, one MLV match will air on the NBC broadcast network on April 11, 2027, as the newcomer Minnesota Forge hosts the defending MLV Champion Dallas Pulse.



  • Friday Nights on Scripps Sports and ION: MLV will expand its over-the-air television distribution with Scripps Sports; 18 matches overall - including franchise Friday night primetime coverage of 15 matches - beginning on the new Scripps Sports Network and transitioning to ION following All-Star weekend. ION will once again be the exclusive home of MLV Championship Weekend, airing the league's semifinals and final.



  • Watch All Week on ESPN: Weekends and other weeknights will be for ESPN networks, providing additional opportunities for fans to watch the league. ESPN networks will carry at least 91 MLV matches, plus the upcoming MLV Draft next week on Monday, November 23 at 7 pm ET on ESPN+ on the ESPN App.



  • CBS and CBS Sports Network: CBS will return to broadcast the 2027 MLV All-Star Match on March 27 (also streamed on Paramount+), following last year's event that peaked at 672,000 viewers. CBS Sports Network will also carry 10 MLV matches during the upcoming season, further expanding the league's presence across the CBS Sports portfolio. 

The ESPN relationship also creates opportunities to introduce MLV to international audiences, with matches available to stream on Disney+ in select countries. 

Together, these relationships create a more accessible and consistent viewing experience for fans while expanding the league's national profile and introducing MLV to new audiences across broadcast, cable, streaming, and digital platforms. 

A DEFINING MOMENT FOR MLV AND WOMEN'S PROFESSIONAL SPORTS

"This is a watershed moment for Major League Volleyball," said Jaime Weston, Commissioner of MLV. "We have an incredible opportunity to introduce our sport to a much wider audience of sports fans, and this media lineup allows us to do exactly that. Bringing together this many blue-chip media partners is a powerful statement about their commitment to Major League Volleyball and their belief in the future of this sport. It reflects the momentum behind women's volleyball and the opportunity ahead of us. We are building a league that fans can follow week after week, and this is a major step forward in our growth." 

The media partnerships reflect the continued investment in women's sports and the growing opportunity for professional women's volleyball in the United States. By combining national broadcast exposure with streaming and digital access, MLV is creating more ways for fans to discover the league, follow its athletes, and engage with its teams throughout the season. 

"Women's volleyball has tremendous momentum, and we see a significant opportunity to help bring that energy to an even broader audience as it joins our robust roster of women's sports," said Jon Miller, President, Acquisitions and Partnerships, NBC Sports. "With compelling competition, outstanding athletes, and a growing fan base, we're excited to partner with MLV to bring more of the sport's biggest moments to fans across the country and to be part of its continued growth." 

The 2027 season will feature 12 teams, including five new teams joining the league, marking another significant milestone in MLV's continued development. The expanded media platform will help support the league's next phase of growth, increasing visibility for its athletes, creating greater opportunities for commercial partners and strengthening connections with fans nationwide. 

"As the women's sports ecosystem continues to evolve, serving our fans is always at the forefront," said Susie Piotrkowski, Vice President, Women's Sports Programming & espnW. "Major League Volleyball brings together elite athletes and compelling competition, and we're happy to showcase the league across ESPN networks." 

MLV worked with Karen Brodkin, COO/Head of Media Advisory, WME Basketball and Hillary Mandel, EVP of global sports marketing agency IMG, on its media strategy and partnership development. 

"We've been proud to play a role in volleyball's growing popularity worldwide through our partnership with MLV this past season," said Brian Lawlor, president of Scripps Sports. "We look forward to building on that momentum by showcasing these elite women athletes and their sport to even broader audiences across Scripps Sports Network and ION in 2027." 

With a consistent weekly schedule, expanded national distribution and a growing roster of media partners, MLV is entering its fourth season with an ambitious vision to make professional women's volleyball a regular destination for sports fans across the country. 

"CBS Sports has been a partner for Major League Volleyball since its inception," said Billy Stone, CBS Sports. "We look forward to an exciting 2027 season and continuing to showcase the growth of professional women's volleyball."

For the complete 156-match regular season schedule for 2027, along with team rosters, ticket information, and live match updates, visit mlvb.com and follow MLV across all official social media platforms.

WASHINGTON, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- EWTN News today announced a bold expansion of its flagship broadcast EWTN News Nightly and named a new generation of on-air talent to lead it. The changes are part of a broader effort to reach the next generation of Catholics, engage audiences on the digital platforms where they increasingly get their news, and ensure the long-term strength of EWTN's mission.

EWTN increases airtime for daily news and pro-life digital offerings, and moves Spanish-language show to Washington

EWTN News award-winning reporters Catherine Hadro and Mark Irons will lead the newscast for the new hour-long EWTN News Nightly, bringing extensive experience covering the Church, the Vatican, public policy and the most consequential stories affecting Catholics in the United States and around the world.

International journalist Colm Flynn will join the expanded program as foreign correspondent, with a particular focus on investigative reporting, the life of the global Church, and the people and communities often overlooked.

"EWTN News is focusing the resources entrusted to us on our flagship daily broadcast that reaches the widest possible audience with trusted journalism through the lens of the Catholic faith," said Michael Warsaw, Board Chairman and CEO of EWTN. "EWTN News Nightly has continued to build and sustain its audience since the election of Pope Leo XIV. By bringing together some of our most experienced next-generation journalistic talent, we can produce a stronger newscast, invest more deeply in original reporting and bring that work to audiences wherever they are and on whatever platform they choose to watch."

The expanded News Nightly will provide comprehensive coverage of the Church, the Holy Father, the United States, and the world. Pro-life reporting will remain an essential part of the program's daily editorial agenda, ensuring that questions concerning the dignity of human life continue to receive serious, consistent and informed coverage.

EWTN Pro-Life Weekly will conclude as a standalone program following its final broadcast on Dec. 9. Its reporting priorities will continue through News Nightly's expanded pro-life coverage.

EWTN News In Depth will also conclude as a standalone program, with the closing broadcast airing Dec. 11. The show's focus on longer-form storytelling, analysis, and reporting on the life of the Church will become regular elements of the longer News Nightly format.

As a part of the restructuring of the news programs, Warsaw announced the consolidation of some staff positions across the news division and expressed his deep gratitude for their contribution to EWTN's mission. 

"The teams behind Pro-Life Weekly and News In Depth have done exceptional work," Warsaw said. "They have told stories that mattered, defended the dignity of the human person, and helped viewers understand the life of the Church more deeply. We are profoundly grateful for what they have built. The strongest elements of both programs and the legacies of the teams who created them will remain part of EWTN News and shape how we continue to meet our audiences in an evolving digital landscape."

The new version of EWTN News Nightly will debut January 11 days before the network's coverage of the March for Life.

EWTN Noticias goes to Washington

EWTN News also announced the Spanish-language program EWTN Noticias will move its production studio from Lima, Peru to Washington in 2027.

The show will debut with a fresh look and an expanded U.S. presence while maintaining its deep reporting network and close connection to the Church and Catholic communities throughout Latin America. The Washington-based production will make it possible for EWTN Noticias to draw more readily upon EWTN News reporting from the across the nation, the Vatican, and around the world while preserving its distinct Latin American identity and editorial expertise.

"EWTN Noticias will bring together the strength of our reporting throughout Latin America with the resources of our Washington newsroom and our global news operation," said Ursula Murúa, President of EWTN News, who was tapped to head the news division after nine years directing digital strategy. "Viewers will recognize the depth and fidelity they trust, presented with a fresh visual identity and a truly global perspective."

These changes build upon a year of major investments by EWTN aimed at strengthening its digital outreach. The network rebranded its news services under EWTN News and upgraded to more user-friendly digital platforms for EWTN News and EWTN News Español. Recently, EWTN revamped its online store, EWTN Religious Catalogue.

Earlier this year, EWTN launched its free streaming app EWTN+ and debuted several new original series and podcasts, including Seeking Beauty with David Henrie, Catholics and Cappuccinos with Siobhan Fallon Hogan and the soon-to-be-released It's Not Too Late with Paul Laudiero, the network's first late-night interview show.

The latest developments reflect the network's response to a fundamental change in how audiences find and consume news. The Reuters Institute's 2026 Digital News Report found that 77% of people across 48 markets watch online news video each week. It also found that 27% now watch on-demand news through applications such as YouTube on their television sets, demonstrating how traditional and digital viewing habits are increasingly converging.

In the U.S., Pew Research Center reports that 34% of adults regularly receive news through YouTube. YouTube has also reported that channels publishing a combination of long-form and short-form content experience stronger overall watch time and subscriber growth than channels publishing only long-form video.

The expanded EWTN News Nightly will be produced both as a complete daily newscast and as a source of individual reports, interviews, explainers, investigations and short-form videos designed for digital discovery and distribution. The new structure will also create capacity for additional programming developed specifically for emerging audience habits while continuing to serve viewers on television, streaming services and other traditional platforms.

"Our distribution strategy begins with a simple question: How do we bring trustworthy reporting to the greatest number of souls?" Murúa said. "That requires us to preserve the depth and comprehensiveness of a full broadcast while also creating journalism that can travel effectively across platforms and reach people wherever they consume news about the Church and the world."

More information is available on ewtnnews.com.

About EWTN

In its 46th year, EWTN is the largest Catholic media organization in the world. EWTN's 11 global TV channels and numerous regional channels are broadcast in multiple languages 24 hours a day, seven days a week in more than 160 countries and territories. EWTN platforms also include radio services transmitted through SIRIUS/XM, iHeart Radio, and over 600 domestic and international AM & FM radio affiliates; one of the most visited Catholic websites in the U.S.; as well as EWTN Publishing, its book publishing division.

About EWTN News

Headquartered in Washington, D.C., EWTN News is the global, multilingual news service of the EWTN Global Catholic Network. EWTN News delivers coverage in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German and Arabic, serving Catholic audiences worldwide on its new platform: ewtnnews.com. EWTN News operates leading digital and print platforms including ChurchPOP and The National Catholic Register, a nearly 100-year-old biweekly newspaper with a robust digital presence. It also produces news programs such as EWTN News Nightly, EWTN Noticias, The World Over, and Vaticano.

releases.body:
New projects for Royal Caribbean Group and work for the Georgia Aquarium, as well as a research collaboration with leading emotion scientist Dr. Dacher Keltner, deepen ESI's approach to entertainment design that prioritizes lasting engagement and human connection.

NEW YORK, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ESI, an experience design agency, is leading a new direction for entertainment design, creating destinations that go beyond spectacle to inspire curiosity, deepen human connection and give people reasons to return. Through new projects, expanded capabilities and research, the studio is bringing together storytelling, creative technology and a deeper understanding of human experience to shape entertainment destinations around the world.

The expansion comes as Americans are spending more on travel, entertainment and attractions, creating new opportunities for destinations to compete for people's time, attention and spending. At the same time, the experience economy has a connection problem. Even as people invest more in experiences, measures of social connection are declining. 

A growing body of research suggests that awe can strengthen our sense of connection to other people and the world around us—raising an opportunity for ESI to create entertainment experiences that are a stronger draw, encourage people to stay longer and explore more, and give them reasons to return and share what they experienced with others.

With decades of experience across entertainment, sports, cultural destinations and branded environments, ESI brings together experience strategy and design, storytelling, creative technology and research. The studio is expanding its focus on location-based entertainment (LBE), applying its approach to creating immersive, participatory destinations across new settings. From the White House Public Tour to new projects for Royal Caribbean Group and work with the Georgia Aquarium, ESI is bringing this thinking to cruise ships, aquariums and other forms of entertainment and edutainment. Its broader portfolio includes experience design for WarnerMedia's headquarters and Delta's Terminal C at New York's LaGuardia Airport, where storytelling, technology and the physical environment come together to create engaging destinations.

Across this work is a growing focus on what happens after the initial moment of impact. Rather than designing solely for spectacle, ESI explores how layered experiences unfold over time, reward curiosity and deepen people's connection to a place.

Central to that approach is ESI's ability to work alongside architects from the earliest stages of a project, ensuring experience design is integral to a destination rather than added later. As NBBJ's experiential design studio, ESI brings this integrated approach to projects while also collaborating with external firms and partners around the world across a wide range of scales, markets and settings.

Exploring the Science of Awe 

To advance this thinking, ESI and NBBJ are launching a collaboration with Dr. Dacher Keltner, one of the world's foremost emotion scientists and author of AWE: The New Science of Everyday Wonder and How It Can Transform Your Life. In a first for ESI and Dr. Keltner, the collaboration moves beyond individual project research to establish design principles informed by the science of awe that can be applied broadly across the practice.

A Distinguished Professor of Psychology at the University of California, Berkeley, and faculty director of the Greater Good Science Center, Keltner has spent decades studying emotion and the conditions that give rise to awe, including its relationship to social connection and people's sense of belonging to something larger than themselves.

Together, Keltner, ESI and NBBJ are translating these findings into practical design thinking that strengthens connections between people and place, encourages continued engagement and creates value beyond the initial visit. The initiative builds on ESI's established approach to entertainment design, grounding creative intuition in scientific insight to shape the next generation of experience-driven destinations.

releases.body:
The agentic B2B analytics platform feeds enriched pipeline data back into OpenAI Ads' bidding.

COPENHAGEN, Denmark and NEW YORK, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Agentic B2B analytics platform Dreamdata today launched an OpenAI Ads integration and conversion syncs, so B2B advertisers can see which companies click their ChatGPT ads and whether those clicks become pipeline and revenue. OpenAI Ads' bidding can then optimize for those outcomes instead of clicks.

OpenAI Ads Manager reports cost, clicks and cost per click, but not which companies clicked or whether a sales opportunity followed. B2B marketers can't target by job title, industry or company, so they can't tell whether they're reaching potential buyers. The bidding can only optimize toward what it can see, so without a way to connect each click to pipeline, it keeps buying more of the same clicks, whether or not they ever turn into customers.

What Dreamdata adds

  • See which companies clicked: Dreamdata identifies the company behind each ChatGPT ad click and places it on that company's customer journey next to every other ad network and GTM touchpoint.
  • See what ChatGPT ads are worth: Each click is followed through to opportunities and closed deals, so B2B advertisers can see whether ChatGPT ads drive revenue.
  • Send pipeline back to OpenAI Ads: Dreamdata sends that enriched pipeline data back to OpenAI Ads, so its bidding learns which clicks turn into pipeline, not just which ones fill in a form.

"Most B2B teams will spend their first ChatGPT ad budget on clicks from companies that will never buy, and the bidding will go looking for more of them," says Nick Turner, CEO at Dreamdata. "That's how a promising channel gets written off. Conversion syncs tell OpenAI Ads which clicks became pipeline, so it can find more of them."

The OpenAI Ads integration and conversion syncs are available now.

About Dreamdata

Dreamdata is an Agentic B2B Marketing Analytics Platform that gives marketing teams the most complete view of their customer journey, so they can answer any question about marketing's impact and know where to invest next. Dreamdata unifies GTM data into one account-based data model, including the anonymous visits and ad impressions a CRM never sees, tied to revenue. Learn more at https://dreamdata.io.

Tell your healthcare provider about all your medical conditions, including any side effects from botulinum toxin products, including dry eye; breathing, swallowing, bleeding, or heart problems; plans to have surgery; weakness of forehead muscles; drooping eyelids; have had surgery on your face; are pregnant or breastfeeding or plan to become pregnant or breastfeed.

Using DAXXIFY® with certain other medicines may cause serious side effects. Do not start any new medicines until you have told your healthcare provider that you have received DAXXIFY® in the past.

Especially tell your healthcare provider if you have received any other botulinum toxin product in the last 4 months or any in the past, and exactly which product you received (such as BOTOX®, BOTOX® Cosmetic, MYOBLOC®, DYSPORT®, XEOMIN®, or JEUVEAU®).

Tell your healthcare provider or get medical help right away if you experience a serious side effect. No serious adverse events of distant spread of toxin effect associated with dermatologic use of DAXXIFY® have been reported in clinical studies at the dose of 40 Units for glabellar lines. The most common side effects of DAXXIFY® include headache, eyelid drooping, and loss of ability to move the muscles in your face.

These are not all the possible side effects of DAXXIFY®. For more information, see the full Prescribing Information including Boxed Warning, and refer to the Medication Guide or talk with your doctor. To report side effects associated with DAXXIFY®, please call 1-877-373-8669. You may also report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088 or visit www.fda.gov/medwatch.

releases.title: Overwhelming Bipartisan American Agreement: "Prediction Market" Sports Betting Should be Regulated like Gambling, Wide Acceptance of Legal Gambling as Entertainment
releases.body:
WASHINGTON, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The American Gaming Association (AGA) latest American Attitudes survey finds overwhelming bipartisan agreement that sports bets offered by "prediction markets" should be regulated as gambling, alongside continued enthusiasm for legal gaming as a form of entertainment. The annual survey also highlights widespread public recognition of gaming's economic contributions and recognition of responsible gaming messaging.

Bipartisan Agreement: Sports on "Prediction Markets" is Sports Betting

"Prediction markets" like Kalshi continue to misrepresent their product as investing while 75% of Americans agree that sports betting on a "prediction market" is fundamentally the same product as betting at a sportsbook.

A bipartisan 82% of Americans believe "prediction markets" should be regulated as gambling products rather than financial products. That view spans party lines, with agreement among 84% of Democrats, 82% of Republicans, and 80% of independents.

"Insidiously misrepresenting sports betting as an investment to 18-year-olds, and telling them it can pay their rent or college tuition, is a grotesque business practice that undermines decades of work industry, state, and tribal regulators have done to protect and educate consumers," said AGA President and CEO Bill Miller. "Across party lines, Americans and 47 attorneys general agree that "prediction markets" should be subject to the same rules and provide the same regulatory oversight and consumer protections as state-and-tribal-licensed sportsbooks."

Clear Expectations for Consumer Protections

Americans overwhelmingly believe that "prediction markets" should be subject to the same licensing, responsible gaming and consumer protection safeguards as state-regulated sportsbooks.

  • Nearly three-quarters (74%) believe these platforms should verify that every user is at least 21 years old,
  • The same percentage (74%) agree that "prediction markets" advertisements should include responsible gaming messages and a helpline.
  • Roughly seven in ten believe they should be licensed by the state gaming regulator (71%) and honor state self-exclusion lists (70%).

The results also show the dangers of misleading advertising from "prediction markets" which claim to offer legal betting in all 50 states, while also describing themselves as investment platforms:

  • 50% of Americans wrongfully believe that "prediction markets" are state-licensed sportsbooks.
  • While Americans overall correctly view bets on prediction markets to be as risky as a traditional sports bet, "prediction market" users see their sports betting "investments" as no riskier than a 30-year mortgage or investment in the stock market.

Broad Acceptance for Legal, State-Regulated Gaming

Nearly nine in ten Americans (88%) view gambling as an acceptable form of entertainment and a majority (52%) participated in some form of gambling in the past year. An estimated 113 million adults, representing 44% of Americans, visited a casino during that period to gamble or for other activities.

Americans also recognize the legal industry's economic contributions. Eight in ten (80%) say the casino gaming industry increases tourism and economic activity where it operates with three-quarters crediting the industry with generating critical tax revenue for state and local governments (76%) creating good-paying jobs (74%).

The industry continues to effectively promote responsible play as eighty-five percent of gamblers report seeing or hearing responsible gaming information in the past year.

"Americans continue to embrace legal gaming as mainstream entertainment and value the tourism, jobs, and critical tax revenue our industry delivers to communities across the country," added Miller.

Methodology

The online survey was conducted on Qualtrics September 2–18, 2026, among a nationally representative sample of 2,268 registered voters aged 21 and older. The reported margin of error is ±2 percentage points at the 95% confidence level and is higher for subgroups.

New Orleans investment firm will partner with founder-owned companies that serve teams, leagues, venues, colleges, and fans

NEW ORLEANS, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LongueVue Capital ("LVC"), a New Orleans-based private equity firm that has focused on partnering with founders and entrepreneurs for 25 years, today announced the launch of a dedicated Sports & Entertainment investment strategy. LVC will invest in middle-market companies that provide services, products, and experiences to teams, leagues, venues, colleges, and fans. Doug Thornton, former President of North American Venues for Legends Global and longtime leader of the Caesars Superdome, has joined LVC as Operating Partner to help lead the effort.

New Orleans private equity firm launches Sports & Entertainment investment strategy helmed by Caesars Superdome leader.

Sports and entertainment has become one of the most resilient parts of the consumer economy. Venues are in decades-long modernization cycles and are evolving into year-round destinations. Teams, leagues, and universities are outsourcing more specialized work to best-in-class partners, while spending on amateur sports and live events continues to grow. These are fundamentally human experiences: technology, including AI, can enhance them, but it cannot replace them.

While many sports investment firms have concentrated on franchise stakes and bigger transactions, much of the industry is built by founder-owned companies, from event production firms to venue service providers, that have reached the scale where they need both capital and a strategic partner. LVC sees a clear gap in the middle market and a natural fit with its long history of helping entrepreneurs professionalize and grow their businesses.

LVC will focus on five areas: live event production and experiential services; venue support services; youth and amateur sports; commercial services for teams and leagues; and fan engagement platforms. LVC generally targets companies with $10 million to $100 million in revenue.

"Some of the best businesses in sports are the ones fans never see: the companies that produce the show, run the building, and help teams sell the experience," said Ryan Nagim, Managing Partner and Head of Sports & Entertainment at LVC. "Many of those companies are founder-built and ready for a partner that understands their industry. That's the role we've played for entrepreneurs for 25 years, and Doug gives us real industry depth from day one. I've known him for more than 15 years. His relationships across the industry are unmatched, and he shares our belief that great outcomes come from unique and genuine partnerships with founders and their leadership teams."

Doug Thornton brings four decades of experience in sports, live entertainment, and venue management. Most recently as President of North American Venues for Legends Global, Doug oversaw the operation of more than 200 stadiums, arenas, theaters, and convention centers. He was named General Manager of the Louisiana Superdome (now Caesars Superdome) in 1997 and led its rebuilding after Hurricane Katrina and its reopening in 2006, the largest stadium reconstruction project in U.S. history. Through his career with SMG, ASM Global, and Legends, Doug has built relationships with leagues, teams, collegiate athletic programs, live entertainment producers, and the executives who run them.

"Throughout my career, I've seen how much teams, leagues, and venues rely on outside partners to deliver for fans and athletes, and many of those partners are entrepreneur-built businesses," said Doug Thornton. "LVC has a long track record of helping founders take their companies to the next level through a true partnership mentality. I've known this team for years, I believe in their culture, and I'm excited to bring that approach to the industry where I have spent my career."

This strategy follows a model that LVC has used for years: deploying highly tailored, thematic investment theses with dedicated, seasoned industry executives who help source opportunities and work hands-on with management teams post-closing to drive value creation. LVC's partnerships are built on conservative capital structures, significant growth capital, and meaningful ownership for management teams.

Founders, management teams, and advisors with opportunities in the sector can contact Charles Cox, Partner and Head of Business Development, at ccox@lvcpartners.com or 504.293.3600.

About LongueVue Capital

Founded in 2001, LongueVue Capital is a New Orleans-based private equity firm that partners exclusively with founders and entrepreneurs in the middle market. With over $1 billion of committed capital spanning five funds, LVC provides growth capital, hands-on operating support, and a team of dedicated operating partners with deep industry experience to help companies professionalize and scale. The firm invests across healthcare, transportation and logistics, industrial services, consumer, food and beverage, and sports and entertainment. LVC is backed primarily by institutional and family office investors in addition to current and former portfolio company executives. In 2024, LVC was recognized by Bloomberg as the No.1-performing growth equity fund under $500 million among funds with vintages from 2015 to 2020.

For more information, visit www.lvcpartners.com and www.lvcpartners.com/portfolio/sports-entertainment.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MyStation, a new streaming platform designed to empower the next generation of independent television and audio network owners, just announced its launch, with expansion across smartphones, smart TVs, connected cars, and virtual reality devices soon to follow. MyStation is a multi-platform streaming marketplace, powered by OTTera, that enables creators, brands, and organizations to own and operate independent television and audio networks spanning video, music, live, and talk content, monetized through flexible station-based subscriptions. From influencers and music artists to broadcasters, podcasters, churches, sports clubs, and independent creators, MyStation makes network ownership accessible to anyone with content and an audience.

Creators, organizations, and brands can now own and operate their own television or audio networks without the significant investment, technical expertise, or distribution infrastructure traditionally required. Each station is effectively an independently operated network, with its own brand, programming, audience, and monetization opportunities.

Creators can launch branded stations, manage programming, schedule content, offer live broadcasts, and build direct subscription relationships with their audiences, rather than depending on algorithms or third-party distribution. Getting started is free: a Starter tier requires no upfront subscription, with optional upgrades for advanced scheduling and live broadcasting as a network grows.

"MyStation is built around a simple idea: if you can build an audience, you should have the opportunity to own a television or audio network," said Stephen Hodge, CEO of OTTera. "For decades, network ownership was reserved for companies with significant capital and access to distribution. We're removing those barriers and giving creators the ability to become network owners themselves."

A sports club can now broadcast their live matches and highlights, a church can offer worship services and community programming, and a musician can combine songs, videos, and exclusive releases. Podcasters can run 24-hour talk networks, influencers can launch an original series and live shows, and broadcasters can open specialized networks for new audiences. The creator builds the network; MyStation makes it accessible to the world.

Over the coming weeks, MyStation will expand across smartphones, tablets, smart TVs, connected TV devices, connected cars, web browsers, and virtual and extended reality headsets, giving creators one network on every screen without building an app for each platform.

Instead of buying large bundles, viewers and listeners choose the individual networks they want to support. The platform supports Subscription-Based Premium Audiovisual Content (SPAC), a new monetization model introduced by OTTera that complements advertising-supported video on demand (AVOD), subscription video on demand (SVOD), and free ad-supported streaming television (FAST), giving owners recurring revenue tied directly to their programming. Even small, highly engaged communities can sustain meaningful media businesses through the MyStations programming model.

Powered by OTTera's established streaming technology, MyStation provides content management, programming, scheduling, delivery, analytics, and monetization within a shared marketplace, so creators can focus on programming rather than infrastructure.

"We believe the next generation of television and audio networks will come from places the traditional industry hasn't always looked," added Hodge. "Musicians, athletes, podcasters, churches, independent filmmakers, influencers, and community organizations already have audiences and programming ideas. What they've been missing is an accessible way to turn those relationships into real media networks."

MyStation launches with an initial collection of independent stations, with more networks and devices rolling out in the coming weeks. Creators can start for free, build their network and own their audience.

NEW YORK, Nov. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- CeraVe, the #1 dermatologist-recommended skincare brand in the US1 and recommended by over 80,000 dermatologists worldwide2, announced its first-ever official film partnership with Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures' Dune: Part Three. The campaign brings CeraVe's hydration expertise to the driest planet in cinema, marking the brand as "The Official Moisturizer of Arrakis" ahead of the film's December 18 theatrical release.

The epic conclusion deserves an epic solution! Dune: Part Three marks the epic conclusion to one of the biggest global film franchises of the decade, a billion-dollar saga whose appeal spans the globe. On Arrakis, the driest planet in fiction, every drop of moisture is precious, making the finale a fitting stage for a brand built on hydration.

At the center of the partnership is CeraVe Moisturizing Cream, from #1 Dermatologist Recommended Ceramide Skincare Brand Worldwide3, now offering a new level of efficacy with 120 hours of hydration. Through a series of social films, the campaign brings CeraVe's signature "medutainment" approach to Dune: Part Three, blending skincare science with entertainment.

The Official Moisturizer of Arrakis was created and produced by OBB Bolded, OBB's branded content studio. This campaign continues the partnership between L'Oreal and OBB Bolded, coming off of the Cannes and Clios award-winning campaign: Kevin Durant's 'New Face of Legs.' 'The Official Moisturizer of Arrakis' was filmed in Samalayuca Dunes in Mexico and Mexico City and directed by Maca Rubio from Stink Films.

Arrakis' Most Precious Resource

The brand is debuting the custom media spot "Precious Resource" today. In the spot, which reimagines the lore of spice on Arrakis, there's a twist in the narrative when a character inspired by Dune's Fremen makes an unexpected discovery, begging the question: what is the most precious resource on Arrakis after all?

On November 11, CeraVe debuted a teaser video, "Defy the Desert," that first revealed the brand as "The Official Moisturizer of Arrakis." The spot opens on a Thumper beating rhythmically against the sands of Arrakis, and just when the viewer expects a massive sandworm to burst from beneath the dunes in an explosive surge of sand...instead, a jar of CeraVe Moisturizing Cream rises from the dunes. More social-first content will continue the story in the weeks leading up to the film's release, with a few more surprises from Arrakis along the way.

"On Arrakis, spice isn't the only precious resource—hydration matters, too, and that's where our moisturizer comes in!" said Vincent Chauvière, Global Brand President at CeraVe. "For our first-ever film partnership, we're proud to step into one of cinema's most extraordinary worlds with Dune: Part Three. It's an unexpected pairing, but there's a natural connection between the desert conditions of Arrakis and what we do every day at CeraVe: help people care for dry skin. Through this partnership, we have an exciting opportunity to put the importance of hydration on a global pop culture stage and introduce our skin barrier and ceramide science to new audiences. We're embracing that opportunity with a campaign that matches the imagination of the Dune cinematic trilogy while staying true to CeraVe's signature blend of humor, science and entertainment."

The Science Behind the Epic Solution

As Dune: Part Three brings the saga to its epic conclusion, CeraVe Moisturizing Cream steps in as the epic solution for dry skin. Developed with dermatologists and formulated with three skin-identical ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and MVE Technology, the cream helps restore the skin's barrier and for the first time provides up to 120 hours of long-lasting hydration. In the US alone, one unit is sold every three seconds4.

Like every CeraVe product, the cream is developed with dermatologists and follows CeraVe's formulation charter. The pH-balanced formula contains essential, barrier-restoring ingredients, is free of fragrance and dyes, and is suitable for sensitive and eczema-prone skin. It is accepted by the National Eczema Association, as well as allergy- and dermatologist-tested, with safety, tolerability and efficacy evaluated throughout development.

"While the extreme desert environment of Arrakis may be fictional, the challenges of dry skin are very real," said Dr. Andrew Park, CeraVe Board-Certified Dermatologist. "Maintaining the skin's protective barrier and keeping skin hydrated are essential to healthy-looking skin. I recommend the CeraVe Moisturizing Cream because it's developed with dermatologists to help support the skin barrier while providing up to 120 hours of hydration."

From Arrakis to Audiences Worldwide

Rolling out globally across all continents, the partnership brings "The Official Moisturizer of Arrakis" to fans worldwide. Available in more than 100 countries, CeraVe, the #1 body care dermocosmetic brand5, brings a global reach to match a franchise with a truly global following.

Designed as one global platform that flexes across markets, the campaign pairs content shared worldwide with local adaptations, including insights from local dermatologists and market-specific experiences in select markets. Beyond its co-branded content, the campaign spans paid, earned, social, digital, retail, creator, and experiential activations, continuing through the film's theatrical release on December 18th, 2026 in North America, and beginning on the 16th of December internationally.

Planned activities include out-of-home advertising, Dune: Part Three-inspired media and creator gifting, and corporate screening experiences in select markets. CeraVe is also a sponsor of the film's World Premiere in Hollywood on December 1 and the UK premiere on December 9.

"Our goal is to create partnerships that extend the worlds of our films in ways that feel unexpected, culturally relevant and genuinely entertaining," said Julie Moore, EVP Global Brand Partnerships Warner Bros. Pictures. "For Dune's first-ever venture into body care, CeraVe felt like the perfect partner. Dune: Part Three is the epic conclusion to a sweeping saga, and this collaboration brings together two brands with passionate global audiences in a way that is smart, surprising and incredibly fun. We can't wait for fans to experience it."

The CeraVe x Dune: Part Three partnership was teased on November 11, 2026, and launches globally today, with additional creative and experiences rolling out through the film's theatrical release. Dune: Part Three arrives in cinemas beginning December 18th, 2026 in North America, with international release dates varying by market.

For more information, visit www.cerave.com and follow CeraVe on Instagram (@cerave) for exclusive campaign content and updates.

ABOUT CERAVE

Founded in 2005 with a mission to provide therapeutic skincare for all, CeraVe creates products developed with dermatologists to restore and maintain the skin's natural barrier. releases.title: Glenn Beck Sees Record Audience Growth Following Launch of Mission-Driven Media Company, Torch
releases.body:
Beck rivals Joe Rogan in YouTube views and generates 446 million social media impressions in 28 days, continuing a year of record-setting digital growth.

IRVING, Texas, Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Since launching his new mission-driven media company, Torch, earlier this year, Glenn Beck has experienced a remarkable surge in audience growth, repeatedly setting new digital performance records throughout 2026 and emerging as one of the most-watched personalities in online media.

The latest numbers represent a new milestone in that growth.

Over a recent 28-day period, Beck's YouTube channel generated 40.7 million long-form video views, virtually matching the 40.7 million recorded by Joe Rogan during the same period, according to internal YouTube analytics and third-party data from Viewstats.

Beck also significantly outpaced Tucker Carlson, whose YouTube channel generated just 19.4 million long-form views during the same period.

And Beck's reach extends well beyond YouTube.

Across Facebook, YouTube, X, Instagram, and TikTok, Beck's social media channels generated a combined 446 million impressions in just 28 days, according to internal platform analytics. On Facebook alone, his content delivered 200.4 million impressions and reached 34.2 million unique accounts.

While the latest figures are particularly striking, they are not an isolated spike. According to Torch's internal analytics, Beck's digital platforms have established new performance benchmarks throughout 2026, reflecting sustained audience growth since the company's launch.

That momentum is also reflected in independent research.

A Media Matters analysis identified The Glenn Beck Program among right-leaning news and politics shows experiencing substantial growth on YouTube, with Beck's channel increasing from 65.7 million to 83.9 million views between consecutive five-month reporting periods.

Meanwhile, Edison Research reported an 11% increase in the weekly U.S. audience for The Glenn Beck Program between late 2024 and mid-2026, further demonstrating the expansion of Beck's audience beyond social media.

And Beck's strong audience performance isn't limited to digital platforms. According to Nielsen ratings data provided to Torch, Beck's nationally syndicated daily radio program outperforms the average ratings of the stations that carry his show by 30% among adults ages 25–54, a key demographic for advertisers.

The growth comes during a pivotal new chapter in Beck's career as he prepares to celebrate his 50th anniversary in radio next year.

After decades in nationally syndicated radio, drawing millions of viewers to Fox News, and pioneering subscription streaming with the launch of GBTV in 2011, Beck began a new venture in 2026 with the creation of Torch.

But unlike a traditional media expansion, Torch was founded around a broader mission: helping Americans understand the deeper story behind current events, rediscover their history, and become better equipped to understand and shape the future.

"We didn't build Torch just to create another media company. We built it because I believe Americans are hungry for something bigger. They want the truth. They want to understand their history. They want to connect the dots and know what's coming so they can do something about it.

"That's the mission of Torch. It's about empowering people, building a community, and reminding Americans that they have far more power to shape the future than they've been led to believe.

"People are responding to that mission. They're looking for something worth believing in, something worth building together. And I think we're just getting started."

— Glenn Beck

Beck's growing digital audience reflects a broader shift in how Americans consume news and commentary, as audiences increasingly turn to individual voices and independent platforms rather than traditional media institutions.

For Beck, who continues to host a nationally syndicated radio program carried on more than 430 stations, the growth represents another successful evolution in a career spanning multiple generations of media.

But with Torch, the ambition extends beyond audience size.

The company is building a platform centered on original programming, historical storytelling, educational initiatives, and direct audience engagement, with the goal of turning passive viewers into an informed, connected, and empowered community.

And if the audience growth of 2026 is any indication, that mission is resonating.

About Torch

Torch is a mission-driven media company founded by Glenn Beck in 2026 to inform, educate, and empower Americans. Through original programming, documentaries, historical storytelling, podcasts, and exclusive subscriber experiences, Torch helps audiences connect the dots between the past, present, and future. Learn more at GlennBeck.com.

The United Earth Forces take on the Post-Human Coalition and the AI Substrate in Stardock's massive-scale real-time strategy sequel

PLYMOUTH, Mich., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The ultimate battle between man and machine will be fought on continent-spanning battlefields as Stardock launches Ashes of the Singularity II today with a launch discount on Steam and direct through Stardock. The sequel to the massive-scale real-time strategy game puts players in the middle of a war over humanity's future, fought against enemies that have already surpassed it.

Set in the near future, Ashes of the Singularity II sees humanity in a fight for its own survival against dangerous enemies. The Post-Human Coalition, a faction of humans who have abandoned their physical bodies, has become the most technologically advanced power in the solar system. At the same time, a rogue artificial intelligence has built the AI Substrate, a machine civilization determined to secure its own future at any cost. Caught between them, humanity is losing ground.

The nations of Earth have set aside long-standing rivalries to form the United Earth Forces. Outmatched in technology and weaker unit for unit, the UEF must rely on what humanity still does best: large armies, disciplined infantry, and strategies drawn from thousands of years of military experience.

"To everyone who played the demo, joined the playtest, and helped shape Ashes of the Singularity II, thank you," said Adrian Wright, Vice President of Entertainment at Stardock. "On November 10, humanity's fight for survival comes home to Earth, and we can't wait for you to join it."

Players can lead the UEF through the single-player campaign or take command of any of the three factions in skirmish and multiplayer, each with its own units and style of play.

After participating in Steam Next Fest earlier this year and hosting a public multiplayer playtest in September, the Ashes of the Singularity II development team used player feedback to improve gameplay, balance, performance, and multiplayer stability ahead of the game's launch.

Ashes of the Singularity II Key Features:

  • Massive Armies, Vast Battlefields. Command thousands of units in real-time across continent-sized maps, with Strategic Zoom letting players move seamlessly from orbital command to frontline combat.
  • Face Enemies of Our Own Making. Take command of the United Earth Forces, the Post-Human Coalition, or the AI Substrate, each with unique units, strategies, and philosophies.
  • Be the Commander. Victory comes from planning and logistics, not speed or reflexes, letting players focus on strategy rather than unit-by-unit control.
  • Unify Humanity (Under Your Command). Lead humanity's United Earth Forces against Post-Human expansion and Substrate machinations in a story rooted in a near-future scenario of survival and restoration
  • Endless Replayability. Generate custom battlefields and take on computer-controlled opponents designed by some of the industry's most experienced RTS developers.
  • Multiplayer, Competitive and Co-Op. Join friends or rivals online in head-to-head matches or team up in cooperative battles.
  • All-Terrain Warfare. Defeat humanity's foes on frozen lakes, treacherous mountain passes, and lava-filled chasms.

Ashes of the Singularity II is available now on Steam and direct through Stardock with a 20% launch discount through November 17th. releases.body:
Through a partnership with klyq and Gett, guests can order tenders, wings and more with a click of the TV remote, with orders going straight into Slim Chickens' own ordering platform.

FAYETTEVILLE, Ark., Nov. 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Slim Chickens, the 300-plus-unit fast-casual chicken franchise, is blazing a new way for Northwest Arkansas guests to order their craveworthy favorites by putting its full menu on the biggest screens in the house: the Samsung Smart TV home screen. Consumers can now easily order food for delivery via their remote, without picking up a phone or endlessly scrolling through a marketplace delivery app.

Slim Chickens is teaming up with klyq, the shoppable streaming marketplace, and Gett, the First Party Everywhere (FPE) direct-to-merchant ordering network built to bring restaurants into the agentic commerce era. Viewers simply select the Slim Chickens home screen advertisement, watch short-form brand content, and add tenders, wings, sandwiches and sauces to their order using klyq's patented BuyBar™. Checkout happens on the TV via the remote. No QR code to scan, no app to download, and no reason to pause the show.

Orders placed through Gett's First Party Everywhere network flow straight into Slim Chickens' own first-party online ordering platform, the same one behind the Slim Chickens app and website. There's no third-party marketplace in the middle, no new equipment and no change for the team on the line, and Slim Chickens maintains the customer relationship. For guests, that means paying Slim Chickens' own menu prices, with no marketplace markup.

"The TV has always been where people get hungry. We just made it a place where they can now do something about it effortlessly," said Ben Turner, vice president of brand performance at Slim Chickens. "We're not just renting space on the biggest screen in the house. We're turning TVs into Slim Chickens counters. And because every order runs through our own platforms, we maintain control over the guest relationship and the Slim Chickens experience our customers know and love."

klyq is built on NBTV's patented BuyBar™ commerce platform and is available across more than 80 million U.S. Samsung Smart TVs, with expansion across Vizio, Apple TV and Google TV.

"Restaurants have been advertising on TV for 70 years and asking people to remember them later. klyq closes that gap, enabling instant purchase with home delivery," said Nick Buzzell, co-founder, chairman and CEO of klyq's parent, NBTV. "Slim Chickens understood right away that the craving and the checkout should happen in the same moment. Seeing a brand this focused on its guests put its whole menu one click from the couch is exactly what we built klyq for."

Gett's First Party Everywhere network includes more than 40,000 partner restaurants and connects them to high-traffic consumer channels such as AI assistants, smart TVs, video games and social platforms.

"TV is about to become one of many new consumer front doors for how people discover brands and order from their favorites," said Paul Stoltz, founder and CEO of Gett. "Slim Chickens is showing the industry what it looks like to meet guests where they are, while solving major pain points for both consumers, who can order food more affordably, and for restaurants, who can reclaim the customer relationship and hold onto margin previously and painfully paid out to third-party marketplaces."

Northwest Arkansas is a fitting place to start. Slim Chickens opened its first restaurant in Fayetteville in 2003 and now has more than 300 locations across 34 states and four international markets.

"Our guests are changing how they find and order food faster than ever," Turner said. "We want to be wherever they are next, and right now that's the couch. That's how a brand that started in a college town keeps growing into a national one."

Find your nearest Slim Chickens at slimchickens.com.

Slim Chickens opened in 2003 in Fayetteville, Arkansas, with a focus on fresh, delicious food with a Southern flair in a fast-casual setting. Guests can always expect fresh chicken tenders and wings cooked to order and served with 14 flavorful dipping sauces to choose from. With more than 300 locations open and a fanatical following in 34 U.S. states, as well as international locations in the United Kingdom, Germany, Turkey and Malaysia, the eternally cool brand is an emerging national and international franchise leading the "better chicken" segment with a goal to grow over 600 restaurants over the next decade. Southern hospitality is not just for the South; everyone, everywhere can appreciate honest food to socialize with friends and neighbors. For more information on Slim Chickens, visit www.slimchickens.com.

NBTV is a media technology company turning screens into stores. Its patented BuyBar™ commerce platform makes television and streaming experiences directly shoppable, allowing consumers to discover, order, and pay with a single click of their TV remote—without scanning a QR code or interrupting the show. Through its flagship consumer marketplace, klyq, NBTV connects entertainment and advertising to seamless checkout across more than 80 million U.S. Samsung Smart TVs, with expansion across Vizio, Apple TV, Google TV, and mobile devices globally. Working with leading QSR brands, DTC retailers, and content partners, NBTV transforms real-time cravings into measurable, instant commerce. For more information, visit nbtvinc.com and klyq.tv.

About Gett Technologies, Inc.

Gett (Gett Technologies, Inc.) is the world's first truly direct-to-merchant ordering network built to bring restaurants into the agentic commerce era. Gett's First Party Everywhere (FPE) network makes restaurants directly orderable everywhere consumers are or will be. With 40,000+ partner restaurants and native integrations across leading online ordering platforms, Gett lets high-traffic consumer channels like AI assistants, smart TVs, video games and social platforms turn restaurant ordering into a new revenue stream. Gett's FPE model solves a long-standing industry problem and offers a better path forward for online food ordering, one where restaurants, platforms and consumers all win. Learn more at Gett.co.

It also explores the subtle choices and unpredictable events that alter the course of an individual's lifetime.

In "PINBALL: Remembrances of a Flaneur," by Marshall Barber, readers are provided an autobiographical look at Barber's experiences coming to terms with his sexuality, navigating psychological turmoil and finding refuge in the unpredictable world of pinball, a game that becomes a metaphor for life's random rewards and reversals of fortune. Set against the cultural backdrop of the 1960s and the decades that follow, the narrative moves between lived experience and alternate realities as the text examines personal character and the consequences of choices made.

"I wrote this book to explore the many realities that can exist within a single life," said Barber. "PINBALL moves through decades of experience, asking readers to consider how differently a life might unfold based on the choices we make."

With a rock 'n' roll DJ for a father, the upbringing exposed the narrator to a constant stream of personalities and experiences, shaping a lifelong tendency to observe and wonder. Through a career spanning state politics and real estate, the story details being involved in people's lives in an immersive way. Barber shares about a near-fatal car accident, a Kansas tornado, political intrigue, a charismatic politician and an addicted painter struggling to reclaim her art.

"One of the questions I found most compelling was what becomes possible when two people are drawn to one another but choose not to have an inappropriate relationship," said Barber. "Sometimes, the most interesting story is the one that happens because we make a different choice".
