Muñoz, an executive coach, organizational consultant and author, introduces the research-informed SPECS framework: five professional roles designed to help individuals navigate their careers and organizations support their growth.

SPECS stands for Subject Matter Expert/Mentor, Peer, Executive Sponsor, Coach and Spokesperson/Advocate. Mentors share expertise; peers provide perspective and accountability; executive sponsors open doors; coaches help professionals reflect and act; and spokespersons/advocates amplify their work when they are not in the room. Together, Dr. Muñoz calls these five distinct yet complementary roles the "Circle of Success."

Drawing on more than 15 years of experience in HR, organizational development and executive coaching, Dr. Muñoz offers a research-informed, practical approach to identifying support gaps and building an intentional Circle of Success. The book includes a mapping worksheet and reflection questions to help readers assess their existing support networks and identify opportunities for growth. For employers, the framework offers a lens for strengthening leadership development, talent mobility, sponsorship, coaching and cultures of advocacy.

"Success is never a solo endeavor," Dr. Muñoz writes. "A mentor helps you learn, a peer helps you navigate challenges, a sponsor opens doors to opportunities, a coach helps you gain clarity and turn insight into action, and an advocate helps ensure your voice is heard. These roles are not interchangeable. Together, they create a Circle of Success that supports individual growth and helps organizations develop talent."

"Who Are Your SPECS? Redefining Career Empowerment for the Future of Work" challenges professionals to rethink career advancement in an evolving workplace. Through practical tools, reflection, and the SPECS Framework, the book encourages readers to build intentional relationships while helping organizations create environments where talent can grow, gain visibility, and access opportunities.

The organization's national event calendar includes the HBCU All-Star Games, the MBP All-American Game presented by Adidas, the MBP Collegiate League and the MBP Junior World Series.

"When I founded Minority Prospects in 2020, my vision was simple: to create a platform where every young athlete has the opportunity to be seen, evaluated and recognized, regardless of their background," said Alexander Wyche, CEO and Founder of Minority Prospects. "Partnering with Perfect Game, the world's leading amateur baseball and softball organization, is a major step forward in that mission. Together, we can expand opportunities, increase exposure and help ensure that talent, not access, determines a young athlete's future."

releases.body:
New radio expands Askey's portfolio for dedicated enterprise wireless deployments

FREMONT, Calif., Nov. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Askey today announced the SCU5050, a new 4×4 MIMO small cell radio for private 5G networks. The SCU5050 gives enterprises, system integrators, and network providers a new option for building dedicated wireless infrastructure around their operational needs.

Private 5G networks allow organizations to tailor connectivity to their facilities, applications, and users. As the radio component of a private 5G deployment, the SCU5050's 4×4 MIMO architecture can help improve spectral efficiency and capacity, supporting environments where multiple devices and applications share the network.

This makes the SCU5050 a strong fit for private 5G deployments in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, enterprise campuses, and other settings that depend on reliable wireless connectivity. Within a properly designed network, it can support use cases such as connected equipment, mobile workforce communications, industrial sensors, and video applications.

"Enterprises need wireless networks that align with the way their businesses operate," said Minchul Ho, SVP at Askey. "The SCU5050 brings 4×4 MIMO radio capability to private 5G deployments, helping our customers and partners build connectivity solutions around their coverage, capacity, and operational requirements."

Key product highlights include:

  • Advanced 4x4 MIMO Technology: Designed to enhance spectral efficiency, wireless capacity, and overall network performance.
  • Small Cell Architecture: Compact radio design intended to support flexible deployment across a variety of network environments.
  • Enterprise Connectivity: Addresses the growing requirements for reliable wireless communications in industrial and commercial applications.

releases.body:
Newly published by Palmetto Publishing, the book gathers forty-eight verbatim quotations from Donald J. Trump, each followed by a footnote naming the speaker, the venue, and the date.

CHARLESTON, S.C., Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Palmetto Publishing has released Not My President, a compiled collection of presidential quotations drawn entirely from the public record. The book presents forty-eight numbered entries, one quotation apiece, each followed by a plain citation. The compiler adds no jokes and offers no analysis. The quotations are reproduced as delivered, with the speaker, occasion, city, and date attached.

The book opens on a signing ceremony. On July 10, 2019, at the signing of an executive order on advancing American kidney health in Washington, D.C., the sitting President said, "The kidney has a very special place in the heart." In Not My President the sentence appears exactly as spoken, the footnote arrives, and the page turns to the next entry. The sources span rally stages, Oval Office scrums, cabinet meetings, Twitter, a livestream, a town hall, and the deck of Air Force One, from a 1999 interview with the New York Times to remarks made deep into a second term.

The entries are grouped loosely by subject rather than chronology. Health care sits near testing and kidneys. Tariffs sit near inflation. Generals sit near the Civil War. Kim Jong-un sits near a stretch of North Korean beach described as a fine site for condominiums. Read in sequence across three decades of transcripts, the repetitions begin to look less like isolated gaffes and more like a method. What emerges is a portrait assembled out of the subject's own sentences.

The author stated, " My life has taught me the importance of being politically impartial. To objectively examine the policies proposed and implemented by our elected leaders. But most importantly to honestly examine the results of those policies. Today we see Americans divided politically, as if we are fans cheering for our favorite team to win. I spent years listening to how American institutions talk about themselves, and I came away with a sense of the distance between what gets said behind the podium and what gets put into practice. That widening gap is the inspiration for this book." 

The book is positioned for politically engaged adult readers who follow the news closely, prefer dry humor delivered without commentary, and want the primary sourcing that turns a punchline into a citation. It sits alongside quotation anthologies and documentary political humor rather than analysis or memoir, and arrives at a moment when claims about who said what, and when, circulate faster than the transcripts behind them. At roughly a quotation a page, it is built for browsing and for checking.

The author is a veteran of the Global War on Terror who was raised in New England by parents born in the Jim Crow South, a background the author credits for a long-standing interest in what official rhetoric can cost the people it describes.

Not My President is available for purchase online at Amazon.com and BarnesandNoble.com. For more information about the author, please visit www.notmypresident.net

About the Author: Before compiling a book of other people's words, the author spent years listening to how American institutions talk about themselves. A veteran of the Global War on Terror, the author came away from that service with a close, firsthand sense of the distance between what gets said at a podium and what gets carried out by the people under it. That gap is the subject of Not My President.

Raised in New England by parents born in the Jim Crow South, the author grew up with a generational memory of what official rhetoric can cost the people it describes. It is a lens that tends to make a person careful about sourcing. Every entry in Not My President: Dumb Things Said by the 45th and 47th President of the United States carries a date, a venue, and a speaker, and the compiler adds nothing else. The joke, such as it is, belongs entirely to the record.

The author describes the project as the work of an independent thinker rather than a partisan one, which in practice means a refusal to editorialize where a transcript will do. Rally remarks, Oval Office asides, cabinet meetings, a tweet at midnight: the quotations are gathered, numbered, footnoted, and left alone. Readers can draw their own conclusions.

The boundaries between organic visibility, paid advertising, and brand influence are converging, as AI reshapes consumer purchase decisions. Marketers need decision-grade intelligence to understand where paid investment can have the greatest impact for their target audiences.

The Bluefish AMP identifies where a brand is absent, misrepresented, or already recommended in AI-generated answers, directs paid media to those gaps and opportunities, and measures the overall impact. The need for a unified approach is accelerating as AI advertising grows. U.S. spending on advertising adjacent to AI-powered search results is projected to reach $26.4 billion in 2026, according to EMARKETER, while ChatGPT Ads has reached approximately $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate.

Still, most paid media teams lack visibility into the organic AI context surrounding their paid placements. New Bluefish Intelligence research found across 5,810 buying topics and 3 categories, different brands lead AI-generated answers on Google and ChatGPT in 35% of cases. These variations make organic AI intelligence critical to understanding where paid investment can have the greatest impact.

"The agentic funnel doesn't distinguish between organic and paid marketing, and neither should the platforms marketers use to manage it," said Alex Sherman, cofounder and CEO of Bluefish. The result is a new operating model for agentic marketing: one that connects paid and organic strategies, coordinates execution across marketing functions, and creates a more complete picture of brand performance in AI.

"AI is fundamentally changing how marketing strategies are built and executed," said Jing Feng, cofounder and COO at Bluefish. Arcturus Publishing and Simon & Schuster will release his debut books, The Fast Cars Coloring Book (November 2026) and How to Create Storyboards for Action (January 2027).

Both are available for pre-order now.

These books are part of a larger effort by Liberatore to share filmmaking techniques and support new artists. This is both altruistic and practical, especially during the current downturn in entertainment industry jobs.

A self-made talent who bypassed traditional film school to become a three-time Art Directors Guild nominee and winner, Liberatore actively mentors emerging visual storytellers. In tandem with the books, he hosts The Action Lab—a free weekly masterclass on Discord where he breaks down iconic action scenes shot-by-shot—alongside instructional videos on his YouTube channel and dedicated portfolio insights at bigscreenboards.com.

The two upcoming titles offer distinct entry points into his dynamic cinematic world:

  • The Fast Cars Coloring Book (Releasing November 2026): Features 45 high-octane, storyboard-inspired illustrations of Hollywood's most iconic vehicles and set-pieces, allowing automotive enthusiasts and film buffs to color the action themselves.
  • How to Create Storyboards for Action (Releasing January 2027): A comprehensive, graphic novel-style industry guide. It features an exclusive foreword by Oscar-winning director Ryan Coogler. The book reveals how a director's primary visual blueprint dictates every moving part of a massive production—from cinematography and stunt choreography to final editing.

Packed with granular career advice, technical industry tips, and spectacular behind-the-scenes artwork, Liberatore's upcoming releases are essential text for film fans, comic lovers, and future filmmakers looking to master a digital-age craft.

PITTSBURGH, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Unifying Spirits, creator of Boba POPS®, is proud to announce the appointment of David Li, PhD, as Director of Research and Development. Li will lead the company's research and development, including a long-term initiative to turn its popping boba into a delivery system for protein, caffeine, and dietary fiber, an expansion sparked by the success of Boba POPS®.

Li brings a rare combination of laboratory science and commercial strategy. He earned his PhD in Biological and Biomedical Sciences from Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis and holds dual bachelor's degrees in Mathematical Economics and Biochemistry from Wake Forest University, where he graduated cum laude and was named Graduate of the Year by the Department of Mathematical Economics. For four years, he advised life sciences companies with The Biotechnology and Life Sciences Advising (BALSA) Group, rising to Director of Marketing and leading teams that sized markets, mapped competitors, and built growth strategies for clients in cell therapy, medical devices, surgical imaging, and manufacturing. He also served as an associate with Oracle's Life Sciences Solutions group.

"Boba POPS® proved that a popping pearl can carry so much more than flavor, and David is the person who will show the world just how much more," said Harmon Rozycki, COO of Unifying Spirits. "Protein, caffeine, and fiber are things millions of people reach for every single day. We believe our pearls belong right there with them, and this is the beginning of a much bigger Unifying Spirits."

"Good science and good business don't always live under the same roof," said Li. "At Unifying Spirits, they do, and that made joining an easy decision. I've spent my career working between the two, from biochemistry and PhD research to helping life sciences companies build their growth strategies. Boba POPS® gives me a proven, patented product to build on, and I'm excited to take it far beyond the cocktail glass."

Boba POPS® is the catalyst for this expansion. What began as a way for consumers and bartenders to add bursts of flavored spirits to their drinks is now sold in more than 6,000 retail doors across 45 states and has grown into the new Pop & Go™ RTD cocktail line. Along the way, Unifying Spirits developed and patented the fill process that keeps its popping pearls shelf-stable in finished drinks, and that same technology is what makes a functional line possible. Pearls built to carry spirits can be engineered to carry functional ingredients.

The new pipeline targets three of the fastest-growing corners of food and beverage. Protein-filled pearls, engineered to hold their structure, will serve fitness- and wellness-focused consumers in a high-protein RTD category projected to grow about 10% annually through 2033. Caffeinated pearls will bring an energy boost to the brand's existing flavors and colors, opening the door to a caffeinated beverage market estimated at $92 billion in 2026. And fiber- and probiotic-enriched pearls will tap into surging demand for gut health, a category whose momentum was underscored by PepsiCo's $1.95 billion acquisition of Poppi in 2025.

Experimentation on the functional lines began this quarter. Li is already making his mark on the core Boba POPS® portfolio as well with new technology that keeps differently flavored pearls distinct in a single drink, laying the groundwork for what comes next.

Boba POPS® (Pearls Of Popping Spirits) are the first and only alcohol-filled popping boba, delivering a sensory-driven way to enjoy spirits. Available in Blueberry, Strawberry, Raspberry, Peach, Lychee, Espresso, Margarita, Piña Colada, and Pumpkin Spice Style, in 50 ml and 375 ml formats, the brand is sold in more than 6,000 retail doors across 34 states, including ABC Fine Wine & Spirits, Kroger, and Albertsons. Learn more at bobapops.com.

Unifying Spirits is an innovation-driven beverage company that develops and scales differentiated products in the spirits industry. Led by a management team with a track record of building and exiting high-value beverage brands, the company pairs patented manufacturing processes with purpose-built U.S. production facilities. Unifying Spirits is the creator and sole producer of Boba POPS®. Learn more at unifyingspirits.com.

  • Agreement reached to acquire Logan Energy Corp. for C$1.40 per share in cash for total consideration of approximately $890 million (C$1.26 billion) including the assumption of Net Debt

  • Transaction is expected to be immediately and long-term accretive across all key financial metrics including Non-GAAP Cash Flow per Share accretion of approximately 5% in 2027
  • Annual cost synergies expected to total approximately $60 million

DENVER, Oct. 26, 2026 /CNW/ -- Ovintiv Inc. (NYSE: OVV) (TSX: OVV) ("Ovintiv" or the "Company") and Logan Energy Corp. ("Logan") (TSXV: LGN) today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement whereby Ovintiv will acquire all of the outstanding shares of Logan in an all-cash transaction that values Logan at approximately $890 million (C$1.26 billion) including expected Net Debt at closing. The acquisition is expected to add approximately 420 total net 10,000-foot equivalent oil well locations, and approximately 266,000 net acres (approximately 200,000 core acres, 80% undeveloped) in the Montney oil window. Current production from the acquired assets is approximately 20 MBOE/d (approximately 7 thousand barrels per day ("Mbbls/d") of oil and condensate, 70 million cubic feet per day ("MMcf/d") of natural gas and 1 Mbbls/d of other NGLs (C2 to C4)). The assets are located in close proximity to Ovintiv's existing Montney operations and include two new oil batteries and additional natural gas processing capacity.

"This bolt-on transaction delivers value for our shareholders by adding high margin oil and condensate production and infrastructure, utilizing our operational advantage to drive significant synergies, and adding to our already deep drilling inventory and future growth optionality," said Ovintiv President and CEO, Brendan McCracken. "The Logan assets have demonstrated leading oil productivity performance and will immediately compete for capital alongside the rest of our portfolio."

The transaction is expected to be funded through a combination of the Company's cash on hand, borrowings under its credit facility and its commercial paper program.

1)

Premium return well locations defined as generating a greater than 35% internal rate of return at $55/bbl WTI oil and $2.75/MMBtu NYMEX natural gas prices.

2)

Assumes PDP value of $27,500/BOE/d.

Transaction Overview:

  • Immediately Accretive – The transaction is expected to be immediately and long-term accretive across key operational and financial metrics including Non-GAAP Cash Flow per Share of 5%, and Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow per Share of 3% in 2027.
  • Increases Montney Scale – The transaction is expected to add approximately 420 total net 10,000-foot equivalent oil well locations (220 premium return locations and approximately 200 upside locations, all located in the Simonette and Pouce Coupe areas). Ovintiv's core land position in the Montney is expected to increase to approximately 720,000 net acres. Also included in the transaction is approximately 60,000 net acres with exposure to the Duvernay shale. A map of Ovintiv's pro forma acreage is available on its website at: https://investor.ovintiv.com/image/OVV+Pro+Forma+Montney+Map.pdf.
  • Significant Synergies – The transaction is expected to generate cost synergies of approximately $60 million annually, comprised primarily of capital savings, production cost savings and overhead cost reductions. Capital cost savings are estimated at more than $2 million per well across the acquired assets, consistent with Ovintiv's current Montney well costs.
  • Infrastructure Ownership – Logan has 100% ownership in two new oil batteries in Simonette with combined capacity of 24 Mbbls/d, the first of which came online during the third quarter of 2026, and the second is expected to come online by the end of the first quarter of 2027. Logan also has 50% ownership at a natural gas processing facility in Simonette with total capacity of 90 MMcf/d and 65% ownership in a natural gas processing facility in Pouce Coupe with total capacity of 57 MMcf/d. Ownership in these facilities is expected to enhance Ovintiv's Montney margins and provide future growth optionality.
  • Maintains Strong Balance Sheet – Following closing of the transaction early in the first quarter of 2027, Ovintiv expects its Net Debt to be below $4 billion. The Company's targeted shareholder returns remain unchanged with at least 60% of 2026 Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow expected to be returned to shareholders via share buybacks and regular dividend payments. Beyond 2026, the target range remains unchanged at 50% to 100%.

Refer to Note 1 for information regarding Non-GAAP Measures in this release.

As part of the transaction, 100% of the shares of Logan Oil Corp., a newly formed wholly owned subsidiary of Logan, will be spun out to the shareholders of Logan and will include select Logan assets outside the Montney and Duvernay fairways. **THIS IS AN ATTORNEY ADVERTISEMENT**

SHASTA, Calif., Oct. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Sacramento employment law attorneys, at Blumenthal Nordrehaug Bhowmik De Blouw LLP, filed a class action complaint alleging that Sinclair Television of California, LLC violated the California Labor Code. The Sinclair Television of California,  LLC class action lawsuit, Case No. 211799, is currently pending in the Shasta County Superior Court of the State of California. A copy of the Complaint can be read here.

According to California Labor Law, companies are required to pay employees for all time worked, meaning the time during which an employee is subject to the control of an employer, including all the time the employees are permitted or suffered to permit this work. Allegedly, Defendant required their employees to work off the clock without paying them for all the time they were under Defendant's control. To the extent that the time worked off the clock does not qualify for overtime premium payment, Defendant, allegedly, failed to pay minimum wages for the time worked off-the-clock in violation of Cal. Lab. Code §§ 1194,1197, and 1197.1 

California Labor Code § 226 provides that every employer shall furnish each of his or her employees with an accurate itemized wage statement. According to the Complaint, Plaintiff was paid on an hourly basis. Therefore, Plaintiff's wage statements should reflect all applicable pay periods in which the wages were earned pursuant to  Cal. Lab. Code section 226 (a). Allegedly, the wage statements Defendant provided to Plaintiff failed to identify such information.

For more information about the class action lawsuit against Sinclair Television of California, LLC, call (800) 568-8020 to speak to an experienced California employment attorney today.

Marketplace is the most widely consumed business and economic news program in the country across radio and television, commercial or public broadcasting.

The grant will support financial literacy programs across Marketplace, contributing to its mission to raise economic intelligence. The Economic Opportunity Grant will be used to help package some of Marketplace's strongest reporting and learning content into an accessible digital hub. This project will help lower barriers to financial literacy tools by expanding classroom-ready resources through education partners and engaging audiences within their communities and online, especially on social media.

The initiative is anchored by four of Marketplace's established financial literacy podcasts: Million Bazillion, Financially Inclined, This Is Uncomfortable and Must Be the Money. Together, these shows help listeners at every stage of life understand how finance, business and the economy work — knowledge that can serve them for a lifetime.

"Financial literacy is at the core of our mission to raise the economic intelligence of the nation," said Neal Scarbrough, Vice President and General Manager of Marketplace. "With support from the Nasdaq Foundation, Marketplace can accelerate its efforts to expand the depth, discoverability and reach of this content, empowering Americans at every stage of life with the tools to build stronger financial futures."

"Financial literacy is the foundation of economic opportunity. Through our Economic Opportunity Grant Program, the Nasdaq Foundation is committed to democratizing financial knowledge and equipping under-resourced communities with the tools to share in the wealth that markets create. Marketplace's mission to raise the economic intelligence of the country aligns powerfully with that goal, and we're proud to support their work in making trusted, accessible financial education available to more Americans," said Jailan Griffiths, President of the Nasdaq Foundation and Head of Purpose at Nasdaq.

To learn more about the Nasdaq Foundation's Economic Opportunity Grant Program, visit www.nasdaq.com/nasdaq-foundation. To see Marketplace's full suite of shows, visit marketplace.org.

NEW YORK, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), in partnership with Kidde, and producer Epic Entertainment and Media Group, today announced the renewal of Home for Good for a second season. Following a successful first season that brought home-and-life safety education to viewers nationwide, the series will return to ABC stations nationwide on Saturday, January 9 as part of the "Weekend Adventure" educational/informational (E/I) programming block.

Hosted by Art Edmonds, Home for Good is a home renovation series honoring people who make a difference in their communities.  Each half-hour episode transforms a room or personal space to better serve people who dedicate their lives to helping others. Season 2 will continue to feature first responders while bringing more community champions and service workers into the spotlight, including educators, mentors and volunteers who serve families in need.

The new season will feature people whose work takes many forms, including a firefighter supporting families of children with autism, a teacher whose students bring comfort to young cancer patients, a volunteer who provides food and supplies to people experiencing homelessness, and a mentor who created a free life-skills program for local youth.

The show will also continue its partnership with series' sponsor Kidde, North America's #1 home fire safety brand1.  Season 2 will combine inspiring stories of community service with practical home- and life-safety education, helping viewers identify everyday risks and take action to better protect the people, pets and homes they care about most.

 "For more than 100 years, Kidde has helped families protect what matters most," said Isis Wu, president of Kidde's Global Residential Fire & Safety business. "Through Home for Good, we're able to celebrate people who strengthen their communities while helping families better understand the fire, carbon monoxide and other safety risks they may face at home. By combining inspiring stories with practical education, we're empowering people to take simple steps that can help make every home a safer home."

"We're excited to bring Home for Good back for a second season," said Bryan Curb, president of HMPG. "The series shows what giving back looks like through the people who serve their communities, while giving viewers practical fire and CO safety information they can use at home. That combination reflects the value of E/I programming: stories that educate, inform and offer a meaningful benefit to audiences."

HMPG's current program portfolio comprises more than 30 original series and hundreds of hours of content annually on leading broadcast networks and station groups and on connected TV and streaming platforms. It has a library of 85 series (6,000 episodes) and its content can be found in 100 countries.

About Kidde

Kidde, a leading manufacturer of residential smoke alarms, carbon monoxide alarms, fire extinguishers, and safety accessories, has been helping to keep the world a safer place for over 100 years. Kidde produced the first integrated smoke detection system a century ago and continues its legacy today by delivering advanced fire-safety technology. Kidde is a part of Kidde Global Solutions, global leader in fire and life safety solutions.  For more information, visit kidde.com or follow @KiddeFireSafety on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

About Epic Entertainment and Media Group

Epic Entertainment and Media Group Inc specializes in delivering high-quality scripted and unscripted programming, original series, documentaries, and event television designed to captivate viewers and drive meaningful engagement. With a strong focus on innovative concepts, diverse voices, and cinematic production values, the company develops projects that resonate across broadcast, cable, and streaming platforms.  Founded by Rick Fielding and Art Edmonds, Epic Entertainment and Media Group is committed to pushing creative boundaries while maintaining the highest standards of excellence. Their collaborative approach combines artistic vision with strategic execution—ensuring every production is not only entertaining, but impactful and market-ready.  Epic Entertainment and Media Group isn't just producing television—it's crafting experiences that inform, inspire, and leave a lasting impression.

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries.  Its popular weekly educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks air weekends nationwide including "Weekend Adventure," on ABC stations; "CBS WKND," on the CBS Network; "The More You Know," on the NBC Network; "One Magnificent Morning," on the CW Network; "Mi Telemundo" on the Telemundo Network and "Go Time" on independent stations. releases.body:
Founder Andrea Cordella appointed Global Head of Art as Side establishes new Chengdu studio

CHENGDU, China, Oct. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leading games services provider, Side, today acquired the boutique games art studio, Roboto Entertainment, strengthening its global art capabilities and presence in mainland China. Roboto Entertainment founder and industry veteran, Andrea Cordella, will lead Side's global art division and act as studio head for the new Chengdu site. His team will work closely with Side Shanghai as well as Side's wider network of art and co-development teams spread across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.

"When half the titles at gamescom's Opening Night Live this year were made in China, the world notices. China has long been one of the most important markets for our industry, and I'm fiercely proud of the fact that our team there is hungry for more work, so we're going to grow." said Deborah Kirkham, CEO at Side.

While the games industry has reported a slowdown globally in recent years, the Chinese market is expected to grow by 4% in 2026 and hit $59.8B by 2030. It boasts some of the highest player engagement rates, esports engagement, player hours, and player spend, making the region an attractive space for developers.

"This acquisition is a double-down on a winning regional strategy. With Andrea as our Global Head of Art and a new studio in Chengdu, we now have some of the industry's best environment and world-building artistic talent," continued Kirkham.

Cordella founded Roboto Entertainment in 2014, specialising in environment and world building art for games. The Chengdu-based team has worked on AAA and AA releases across console and mobile games.

Andrea Cordella said, "I knew from the moment I met Deborah and the team at Side that the company aligned with the values my team and I hold dear. We strive for excellence and hold creativity close to our hearts – games are the only art medium where the consumer plays an equal role to the creator, and we will continue to deliver that creativity to every brief, now collaborating with teams across the world and supporting developers on a range of projects. It goes without saying, but I can't wait to get started."

Side's QA offering recently expanded through a partnership with leading AI QA platform, Modl.ai, announced at Gamescom earlier this year. Side, which provides Player Support, QA, Localisation, LQA, Datasets, Codev, Art and Audio, already offers its full suite of services to China-based developers.

The new studio, combined with new expertise in environment art through Andrea and his team, will allow the company to offer developers in China and beyond more than ever before.  

About Side: 

Side is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009, Side has grown from their Japanese roots to become a global force in the technology industry, with 15+ studios in over a dozen countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Their industry-leading services include art production, game development, audio production, quality assurance, localisation, localisation QA, player support, community management, and datasets. For more information, visit www.side.inc

CAMDEN, N.J., Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Subaru of America, through its Subaru Loves Pets® initiative, together with iHeartImpact, a community impact division of iHeartMedia designed to help corporate brands partner with nonprofits through their advertising spends with iHeartMedia, today announced an expanded collaboration with the ASPCA® (The American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals®) to help improve the lives of shelter animals across the country. As part of the partnership, Subaru donated an additional $25,000 to support their ongoing commitment to helping shelter animals find loving homes.

This collaboration builds upon Subaru's 19-year partnership with the ASPCA, which began in 2008 through the Subaru Share the Love® Event. Through the Subaru Loves Pets initiative, Subaru and its retailers are committed to improving the lives of as many shelter animals as possible and are proud to be the largest corporate donor to the ASPCA. With more than $75 million donated to national and local pet-focused organizations, they have supported the adoption, rescue, transport and health of more than 900,000 animals.

Alan Bethke, Senior Vice President of Marketing, Subaru of America, Inc.: "Subaru and our national network of retailers are fortunate enough to partner with the ASPCA and to see the profound impact that a pet's unconditional love can have on peoples' lives. With this additional donation and recognition from iHeartMedia, the work we are doing together as part of Subaru Loves Pets will go even further to support the most vulnerable animals in need, and to help shelter animals find loving homes."

Every October, Subaru retailers partner with local animal welfare organizations to help prepare shelter pets for adoption through ASPCA-administered grants and a series of pet-focused events held in communities across the country. As part of this year's campaign, Subaru will celebrate its eighth annual National Make A Dog's Day on October 22 – a day created by Subaru to encourage dog lovers nationwide to do something special for their dogs while inspiring more people to consider adopting, fostering or supporting an Underdog as a life-changing way to Make A Dog's Day. Subaru is especially passionate about supporting older and disabled dogs – affectionally called the "Underdogs" – who are often overlooked and spend more time waiting in shelters to find loving homes.

Meredith Galli, Director of Corporate Partnerships, ASPCA: "The ASPCA is proud to be the recipient of this generous donation from iHeartImpact, made possible through our longstanding partnership with Subaru of America. We are thankful to Subaru for selecting the ASPCA as the beneficiary of this gift, which will help strengthen our efforts to create better outcomes for vulnerable animals nationwide."

The need remains significant. According to the ASPCA, 5.8 million dogs and cats entered shelters and rescues in 2025, with many waiting day after day for the chance to find a loving home.

Together, Subaru, the ASPCA and iHeartImpact aim to inspire more people to support shelter animals while expanding awareness of Subaru's long-standing commitment to pet adoption and welfare. Through the partnership, iHeartMedia and iHeartImpact will help expand the reach of Subaru's October campaign with a national broadcast initiative designed to encourage audiences across the country to learn more about shelter pet adoption and fostering.

Jenna Craig, President, National Media Team, iHeartMedia: "National Make A Dog's Day is a powerful reminder of the impact each of us can have on the lives of shelter animals. As a media partner that reaches 9 out of 10 Americans every month, we're proud to collaborate with Subaru and the ASPCA to help bring this message to our audiences nationwide and inspire more people to adopt, foster, and support pets waiting for a second chance."

Learn more about how Subaru is supporting shelter animals across the country at Subaru.com/pets.

A proven model

Nomada Fund uses the same financial structure as Media for Equity (M4E) funds, where media groups trade advertising space for equity, with two differences: it operates on New Media platforms instead of TV, radio, or print, and it invests at Pre-seed and Seed rather than at maturity. This makes it the world's first Distribution for Equity (D4E) fund.

With AI agents and no-code tools, a small team can recreate a working product in days. What competitors cannot copy is the trust of people who follow a company, open its emails, and recommend it. Hence the firm's motto: "Distribution is the new moat." A startup's moat, what protects it from competitors, used to be technology. Today, it is the ability to reach the right people and turn visibility into trust.

"A startup's most valuable asset is no longer just its product, but its brand and relationships," said Jose Kont.

SALT LAKE CITY, Oct. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

MEDIA BRIEFING & PRESS ADVISORY

SUBJECT: Media Availability and Briefing: Civil Rights Lawsuit Filed Concerning Witness Interference (Milton v. Essick and Lackey, Case No. 2:26-cv-01005)

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & ADVISORY

A federal lawsuit was filed on October 13, 2026, in the United States District Court for the District of Utah (Central Division) under 42 U.S.C. § 1985(2). The action, titled Trevor R. Milton v. Christopher S. Essick and Paul Lackey (Case No. 2:26-cv-01005), alleges a coordinated extrajudicial conspiracy aimed at intimidating and deterring a key prospective defense witness during federal court proceedings. Members of the press are invited to request interview availability with key individuals associated with the filing.

2. FACTS OUTLINED IN THE COURT FILING

The following factual assertions are derived strictly from the formal Complaint filed in federal court:

  • Parties Involved:
    • Plaintiff: Trevor R. Milton, Founder and former Chief Executive Officer of Nikola Corporation (Nikola).
    • Defendants: Christopher S. Essick (alleged in the Complaint to be an FBI Special Agent assigned to the Counterintelligence Division of the New York Field Office, sued in his individual capacity) and Paul Lackey. Essick worked, and continues to work in the same District of New York that brought charges against Milton in the United States vs. Milton case.
  • Core Allegations:
    • The Complaint alleges that Defendants operated concealed pseudonymous social media accounts (including @lfxs1212, @CntrlScrut1nizr, and @InsiderNikola) while taking financial positions adverse to Nikola Corporation. FBI agent Essick admitted to trading Nikola stock and making money through his burner accounts.
    • The filing alleges that Defendants conducted a targeted online campaign directed at favorable witnesses who were planning on testifying on behalf of Milton such as Jason Roycht, former Vice President of Technology Development at Nikola and a prospective defense witness possessing direct knowledge of Nikola's technology programs and executive communications.
    • According to the filing, the campaign included demands for Mr. Roycht to "turn states evidence," public calls for his indictment, exposure of personal accounts, and assertions of advanced law enforcement knowledge.
  • Alleged Impact on Legal Defense:
    • The Complaint alleges that this harassment caused Mr. Roycht to decline meetings with Mr. Milton's defense counsel, restricting the defense's access to a percipient witness and depriving Mr. Milton of witness assistance during federal trial preparation. Actions targeting witnesses are considered obstruction of justice, witness tampering and potentially RICO related offenses.

3. CONTEXT: MILTON FEDERAL CASE AND PRESIDENTIAL PARDON

To ensure factual accuracy and context regarding Mr. Milton's legal background:

  • Following trial proceedings in United States v. Milton, No. 1:21-cr-00478 (S.D.N.Y.), Mr. Milton pursued legal remedies regarding the trial's fairness and witness access.
  • On March 27, 2025, Trevor R. Milton received a full and unconditional Presidential Pardon for the offenses of conviction in United States v. Milton from President Donald J. Trump.

4. MEDIA INTERVIEW OPPORTUNITIES

Credentialed members of the media may schedule interviews with the following individuals:

  1. Trevor R. Milton — Plaintiff; Founder and former CEO of Nikola Corporation.

OAKLAND, Calif., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Redwood Public Law LLP today announced the formal launch of its Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice, bringing together existing experience across public-private partnerships, sports and entertainment transactions, Name, Image and Likeness (NIL), cultural infrastructure and public law into a dedicated interdisciplinary practice.

The practice is led by Redwood partners Richard D. Pio Roda, Eric S. Casher and Steve Ngo, working alongside Senior Of Counsels Jade Y. Ramos and Neha Shah, whose sports and entertainment practice includes athlete representation, NIL, sponsorship and endorsement agreements, labor and employment issues, and transactions involving artists, creatives, and culture and entertainment organizations.

Together, the team advises public agencies, athletes, artists, creatives, non-profit organizations, and businesses on matters involving contracts and commercial agreements, stadium and venue development, sponsorships and endorsements, governance, public-private partnerships, cultural initiatives and related strategic initiatives.

"Sports, arts and entertainment are integral to and enhance civic life. They shape how communities see themselves, bring people together and serve as catalysts for economic development and community engagement and investment," said Richard D. Pio Roda, Partner and Co-Leader of Redwood's Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice. "This practice formalizes work that Redwood and our attorneys are already doing and brings together complementary experience across public law, transactions, land use and development and the sports and entertainment industries to serve clients across the ecosystem."

Experience Across the Sports, Arts & Entertainment Ecosystem

Redwood's approach reflects the increasingly interconnected nature of sports, arts, entertainment and the public sector.

The firm currently serves as special counsel to the Oakland Acquisition Company, formerly the African American Sports & Entertainment Group, in connection with the acquisition and development of the Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum complex. Ramos previously led the legal team advising the Oakland-based development group in its acquisition effort, work Redwood has continued to advance.

Redwood attorneys also bring experience advising on major sports and entertainment developments throughout California, including the Waterfront Ballpark District at Howard Terminal in Oakland, the redevelopment of Hollywood Park in Inglewood, the ocV!BE mixed-use entertainment district and Honda Center in Anaheim, and DisneylandForward.

That experience encompasses public-private negotiations, real estate and land use, environmental review, development agreements, public finance, construction and public contracting, facility operations and other legal issues that arise throughout the lifecycle of major sports, entertainment and cultural projects.

The practice also extends beyond venues and development. Redwood advises athletes, artists, creatives, sports organizations and entertainment businesses on the legal and strategic infrastructure supporting their careers, organizations and ventures.

The Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice includes:

  • Sports stadiums, entertainment venues and districts, including development, public contracting, land use, environmental review, public finance and facility operations;



  • Public-private partnerships among public agencies, developers, sports and entertainment organizations and nonprofit partners; 



  • NIL and athlete representation, including NIL agreements, institutional and collective arrangements, and strategic matters across collegiate and professional sports; 



  • Professional league and franchise matters, including ownership group representation, league negotiations and expansion bids;



  • Artist and creative representation, including agreements involving music, film, visual art, live performance and digital content; 



  • Contracts and commercial agreements, including talent, event, vendor, production, licensing and distribution agreements; 



  • Sponsorships, endorsements and brand partnerships, including naming rights, venue and event sponsorships, athlete and talent endorsements, brand ambassador agreements, co-branded content;



  • Intellectual property and brand protection, including trademark, copyright, licensing and rights of publicity; 



  • Media and broadcasting matters, including content, distribution and matters for public and community media organizations; 



  • Labor and employment matters for athletes, performers, creative professionals, and the organizations that employ them; 



  • Arts and cultural initiatives, including cultural facilities and districts, public art, murals, exhibitions, creative spaces and creative-economy programs; 



  • Governance, formation and organizational matters for sports, arts, entertainment and nonprofit entities, including foundations and mission-driven ventures;



  • Emerging technology issues affecting athletes, artists and creative businesses, including AI and digital content ownership; and

Government and regulatory matters affecting sports, arts, entertainment and cultural initiatives Ramos brings a distinctive perspective to the practice as both an attorney and former professional and NCAA Division I basketball player. Her experience includes advising collegiate athletes, sports organizations, artists and content creators. She also co-designed and co-instructed the inaugural Name, Image and Likeness legal clinic at UC Berkeley School of Law.

Pio Roda brings extensive experience in transactions, public-private partnerships, governance, public contracting, real estate and land use, while Casher's practice includes complex public agency, development, regulatory and strategic matters. Together with Ramos and attorneys across Redwood's practice areas, the team is structured to address matters that frequently cross traditional legal disciplines.

"Sports and entertainment are changing rapidly, particularly for athletes and creatives who are navigating increasingly complex commercial opportunities," said Jade Y. Ramos, Senior Of Counsel at Redwood Public Law. "Our goal is to help clients understand those opportunities, protect what they are building and create structures that allow their work and ideas to grow."

The launch reflects Redwood's broader commitment to advising clients on complex matters where public investment, private enterprise, culture and community converge.

Redwood will formally celebrate the launch of the Sports, Arts & Entertainment Practice with an event on October 16, 2026 in Oakland at the Historical Rotunda Building located at 300 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza beginning at 5:00pm, PST.

Redwood Public Law LLP is a California public law firm advising public agencies, nonprofits, businesses and other organizations on complex legal, regulatory, transactional and governance matters. Redwood attorneys collectively serve as City Attorney for 16 California cities and as General Counsel to more than 30 special districts and nonprofit organizations. The firm maintains offices in Oakland and Sacramento and advises clients throughout California.

The sequel to the massive-scale real-time strategy game puts players in the middle of a war over humanity's future, fighting against enemies that have already surpassed it.

Set in the near future, Ashes of the Singularity II puts humanity in a fight for its own survival. The Post-Human Coalition, a faction of humans who have abandoned their physical bodies, has become the most technologically advanced power in the solar system. At the same time, a rogue artificial intelligence has built the AI Substrate, a machine civilization determined to secure its own future at any cost. Caught between them, humanity is losing ground.

The nations of Earth have set aside long-standing rivalries to form the United Earth Forces. Outmatched in technology and weaker unit for unit, the UEF must rely on what humanity still does best: large armies, disciplined infantry, and strategies drawn from thousands of years of military experience.

"We're grateful to every player who jumped in during Next Fest and our playtests. Ashes of the Singularity II is a better game because of them," said Adrian Wright, Vice President of Entertainment at Stardock. "On November 10, the fight to save humanity begins in massive-scale RTS battles we're eager for players to experience."

Players can lead humanity through the singleplayer campaign or take command of any of the three factions in instant action skirmish and multiplayer, each with its own units and unique style of play.

Since the Steam Next Fest demo and September's public multiplayer playtest, the development team has continued to improve gameplay, balance, performance, and multiplayer stability based on player feedback.

Ashes of the Singularity II Key Features:

  • Massive Armies, Vast Battlefields: Command thousands of units in real time across continent-sized maps, with Strategic Zoom letting players move seamlessly from orbital command to frontline combat.
  • Face Enemies of Our Own Making: Take command of the United Earth Forces, the Post-Human Coalition, or the AI Substrate, each with unique units, strategies, and philosophies.
  • Be the Commander: Victory comes from planning and logistics, not speed or reflexes, letting players focus on strategy rather than unit-by-unit control.
  • Unify Humanity Under Your Command: Lead humanity's United Earth Forces against Post-Human expansion and Substrate machinations in a story rooted in a near-future scenario of survival and restoration.
  • Endless Replayability: Generate custom battlefields and take on computer-controlled opponents designed by some of the industry's most experienced RTS developers.
  • Multiplayer, Competitive and Co-Op: Join friends or rivals online in head-to-head matches or team up in cooperative battles.
  • All-Terrain Warfare: Defeat humanity's foes on frozen lakes, treacherous mountain passes, and lava-filled chasms that change with persistent damage as the battle rages on.

GOLDEN, Colo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PlanetiQ's GNOMES-10 satellite successfully launched October 1 at 11:32 a.m. PDT aboard SpaceX's Transporter-18 mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base, marking another major step in the company's expansion of its global GNSS radio occultation (GNSS-RO) constellation. Following launch, PlanetiQ's partner ground stations quickly established first contact with GNOMES-10, and spacecraft commissioning began immediately.

"...our data supports weather applications by measuring Earth's atmospheric and ionospheric state," said Chris McCormick

GNOMES-10 Carries PlanetiQ's Fourth-Generation Pyxis Receiver

GNOMES-10 carries PlanetiQ's fourth-generation Pyxis GNSS-RO receiver, which was built and tested at PlanetiQ's facility in Golden, Colorado. Pyxis is engineered to capture exceptionally high-quality GNSS signals for radio occultation measurements. Its combination of high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), high-rate signal sampling, precise timing, and advanced antenna design enables PlanetiQ to retrieve highly detailed atmospheric profiles from each radio occultation event.

Pyxis incorporates a high-accuracy oscillator and PlanetiQ's bespoke satellite antenna design, both engineered to maximize the information captured from each GNSS-RO observation. These capabilities provide detailed measurements of atmospheric structure, including in the lower troposphere and ionosphere.

"Experiencing the launch firsthand is a reflection of, and a tremendous appreciation for, all the excellent hard work by everyone involved, including our employees, suppliers, and customers," said Chris McCormick, Founder, President and Chairman of PlanetiQ. "We are proud that our data supports weather applications by measuring Earth's atmospheric and ionospheric state and furthering our knowledge of Earth's dynamic weather patterns."

Simultaneous GNSS Tracking Creates More RO Opportunities

PlanetiQ satellites simultaneously track signals from all four major GNSS constellations: GPS, BeiDou, GLONASS, and Galileo. Each satellite also uses a wide ±75-degree limb-sounding field of view.

By tracking multiple GNSS constellations simultaneously and observing signals across a wide field of view, PlanetiQ satellites can observe more GNSS transmitters at the same time. This creates more opportunities for radio occultation measurements and enables PlanetiQ to produce more GNSS-RO observations per hour than other commercial RO constellations.

The resulting observations provide weather models and other users with highly detailed information about atmospheric structure. PlanetiQ's high-SNR measurements are particularly valuable for resolving features in the lower troposphere, where atmospheric conditions can change rapidly and where conventional satellite observations can be challenging.

GNOMES-11 to Add Lower-Inclination GNSS-RO Observations

PlanetiQ plans to launch GNOMES-11 later this month, carrying the same fourth-generation Pyxis receiver as GNOMES-10. The addition of GNOMES-10 and GNOMES-11 is part of PlanetiQ's ongoing effort to expand the availability, quality, and diversity of commercial GNSS-RO observations for weather forecasting, space weather, and other mission-critical applications.

About PlanetiQ

PlanetiQ provides the highest-quality GNSS radio occultation (RO) data available from a commercial constellation of satellites, offering unmatched temporal and spatial resolution. The data drive accurate, high-impact weather and climate forecast models, helping improve Numerical Weather Prediction and AI forecasts, safeguard lives and property from severe weather. PlanetiQ is a space-tech company that serves the most mission-critical government, defense, and industry leaders, including international weather agencies, enabling more resilient operations across sectors. Founded in 2015 and privately owned, PlanetiQ designs, builds, and operates the preeminent commercial constellation of GNSS-RO satellites, setting the standard for precision and reliability in atmospheric monitoring. For more information, visit PlanetiQ.

releases.body:
Research initiative under LMC's AI Accelerator will provide benchmarking insights for small and mid-sized businesses, help local media companies strengthen relationships with local advertisers

NEW YORK, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Local Media Consortium (LMC) today announced the launch of its SMB AI Benchmarking Study, a research initiative presented by its Digital On-Demand Services (DODS) division in partnership with Borrell Associates. The second initiative under LMC's recently launched AI Accelerator for Local Media program, the study will examine how small and mid-sized businesses are using artificial intelligence and navigating a rapidly changing business environment. Findings will provide participating SMBs with valuable benchmarking data while helping local media organizations better understand and support local advertisers.

The research comes at a pivotal moment for local media organizations. Data from the 2026 LMC Industry Insights Survey found that the percentage of publishers identifying agency services as a top priority  declined by 80% year over year, highlighting the need for new ways to serve local advertisers and build sustainable revenue streams. The study is designed to help publishers better understand how businesses perceive, adopt and invest in AI while identifying opportunities to provide more valuable guidance, services and support.

Participating businesses from industries ranging from healthcare and professional services to retail, hospitality and home services will gain access to benchmarking insights that compare local findings with broader regional and national trends. Depending on participation levels, businesses may also be able to compare results within specific industries and local markets. Initial aggregated findings are expected in November 2026.

"Small and mid-sized businesses are being asked to make important decisions about marketing, technology and AI at a pace that is often difficult to keep up with," said Fran Wills, CEO of the LMC. "Research suggests concerns about the accuracy of AI-generated information remain widespread among small businesses, reinforcing the need for trusted local partners who understand their markets and can help separate hype from reality. This study will help us better understand what local businesses need most and identify new ways local media organizations can support their growth and success."

The study is expected to identify opportunities for local media organizations to expand the services and expertise they provide to advertisers while deepening their role as trusted advisors. Findings will help publishers better understand how businesses are navigating AI, how AI impacts marketing and technology decisions and where they need additional support.

"I don't think anyone will disagree that AI is already having a profound effect on the way we conduct business. What's still a mystery is how deep the seismic shift is being felt among those very busy, very practical SMBs," said Gordon Borrell, CEO of Borrell Associates. "Past surveys have shown they're yearning for a trusted advisor to help them navigate the complex marketing world. This survey will help us learn whether AI has begun filling that role, and how deeply AI may already be embedded in their marketing activities. I'm confident it will uncover early opportunities for local media companies to complement their migration toward AI adoption."

Participating businesses will have the opportunity to receive a summary of the findings and contribute to one of the most comprehensive studies examining the intersection of AI, advertising and local business growth. The findings will help inform future products, services, educational resources and support programs that strengthen relationships between local media organizations and the businesses they serve.

The SMB AI in Benchmarking Study is part of the Local Media Consortium's AI Accelerator, a broader effort by the LMC and its Digital On-Demand Services (DODS) division to help local media organizations identify new opportunities for growth, strengthen advertiser relationships and develop solutions that meet evolving market needs. The initiative is supported through funding from the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation as part of the News Media Help Desk, an online resource created by the LMC and the Reynolds Journalism Institute to support the long-term sustainability of local media.

About the Local Media Consortium

The Local Media Consortium delivers more than $60 million in annual economic value through digital partnerships and strategic initiatives on behalf of more than 150 local media companies in top markets across the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico, and includes more than 5,000 newspaper, radio, TV and online-only news outlets. By harnessing the combined volume and scale of its members, the LMC reduces costs and increases revenue with technology and service providers. The aggregated LMC audience footprint spans 200 million unique monthly visitors, and its member companies serve more than nine billion pageviews to consumers.

Michael Masiuk joins as Managing Director, focused on growth capital and deal origination

NEW YORK, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- B. Riley Securities, Inc., a leading full-service investment bank, today announced that Michael Masiuk has joined the firm's Investment Banking team as Managing Director, based in New York.

Michael Masiuk joins B. Riley Securities as Managing Director to Expand Technology, Media and Sports Advisory

Mr. Masiuk expands B. Riley Securities' growth and private capital, M&A advisory, and proprietary deal origination capabilities, deepening coverage of corporate and financial sponsor clients in the sports, media, and technology sectors.

"Michael brings deep relationships with founders, operators, and institutional investors, along with extensive experience across public and private capital markets," said Andy Moore, CEO of B. Riley Securities. "His expertise in sports, media, and technology further fortifies our platform, and his addition reflects our commitment to adding senior talent across high-growth sectors."

Mr. Masiuk brings over 25 years of experience across investment banking, hedge funds, and the entertainment industry, with specialized expertise in sports, media, and technology. He possesses a strong track record of originating and executing transactions across public and private capital markets, including growth equity, crossover rounds, and buyouts. His work bridges private growth-stage capital and public market execution, and he has built a proprietary pipeline through long-standing relationships with key industry stakeholders and institutional backers.

"Companies across the sports, media, and technology landscape increasingly need a partner who understands both private growth capital and the public markets," said Mr. Masiuk. "B. Riley Securities' institutional platform enables us to take relationships with founders and investors from first conversation through execution, whether a growth round, a crossover, or a path to the public markets."

Throughout his career, Mr. Masiuk has advised public and private companies on equity, debt, and hybrid financings, and his advisory work spans multiple professional sports leagues and franchises, public and private media companies, and growth-stage technology businesses transitioning to the public markets. He joins from Clear Street, where he was a Managing Director focused on proprietary deal origination, and previously served as a Managing Director at Cantor Fitzgerald and as a partner at The Schottenfeld Group. He holds a B.A. from Saint Anselm College.

For more information about B. Riley Securities' investment banking services, visit www.brileysecurities.com/investment-banking.
